programme.title: Okręty wojenne
Combat Ships
programme.desc: Dokumentalna opowieść o tym, jak technologia zmieniła okręty wojenne. Widzowie poznają historie wielkich bitew morskich, ucieczek i katastrof, które miały miejsce na wodzie lub w głębinach.

programme.title: Porzucona Ameryka 2
Abandoned Americana 2
programme.desc: Autorzy wyruszają w podróż po Stanach Zjednoczonych, by badać zapomniane ruiny i pomniki minionych epok. Każda z opuszczonych budowli rzuca światło na historię danego regionu i jego mieszkańców.

programme.title: Klopp: transfer stulecia
Klopp: The Inside Story
programme.desc: Opowieść o karierze jednego z najwybitniejszych trenerów piłkarskich i jego drodze na szczyt. To on stoi za wielkimi sukcesami drużyny Liverpoolu, która pod jego przywództwem zdobyła m.in. mistrzostwo Anglii. Pochodzący z Niemiec Jürgen Klopp dzięki pracy i talentowi zyskał światową renomę. Stawia na nieustanny rozwój, a nad osobiste ambicje przedkłada działania zespołowe. Jest jednym z najpopularniejszych i najbardziej cenionych menadżerów sportowych. Widzowie dowiedzą się, jak z zawodnika drugoligowego FSV Mainz 05 stał się najlepszym trenerem w Europie, co zmieniło jego pojawienie się w sztabie szkoleniowym brytyjskiego zespołu oraz jaki jest jego przepis na sukces.

programme.title: Furioza
programme.desc: Dzika (Weronika Książkiewicz) wychowała się na jednym osiedlu z kibolami Goldenem (Mateusz Damięcki) i Kaszubem (Wojciech Zieliński). Teraz jako policjantka stoi po przeciwnej stronie barykady i wraz z przełożonym Bauerem (Łukasz Simlat) próbuje rozpracować przestępczy układ, który współtworzą jej dawni kumple. Nakłania do współpracy Dawida (Mateusz Banasiuk), lekarza i zarazem brata Kaszuba, z którym przed laty była związana. On też odciął się od kibicowskiego półświatka. Teraz na nowo ma przeniknąć w szeregi agresywnych i gotowych na wszystko bandytów. Jeśli pomoże w śledztwie, może uchronić brata przed więzieniem.

programme.title: Montana: na dzikiej północy
Montana Wild
programme.desc: Montana jest zdecydowanie jednym z najdzikszych miejsc w USA. Widzowie poznają tutejszych myśliwych, traperów i rolników, którzy starają się żyć w symbiozie ze środowiskiem.

programme.title: Srebrny Montreal 50 lat później
programme.desc: Podczas turnieju piłkarskiego na Letnich Igrzyskach Olimpijskich w Montrealu w 1976 roku reprezentacja Polski sięgnęła po srebrny medal. W finale, rozegranym 31 lipca na Stadionie Olimpijskim, Polacy przegrali z NRD 1:3, a królem strzelców został Andrzej Szarmach, zdobywając 6 bramek. Pięćdziesiąt lat później "Orły Górskiego" spotykają się w Muzeum Sportu i Turystyki w Warszawie. Wydarzenie z udziałem publiczności prowadzi Dariusz Szpakowski, a Waldemar Malicki muzycznie przywołuje klimat tamtych lat.

programme.title: Sport w Polsce - sto lat historii
programme.desc: Dokument stanowi podsumowanie sukcesów polskich sportowców na przestrzeni wieku. Twórcy filmu przedstawiając ich osiągnięcia i porażki, uwzględnili kontekst zmian w światowym ruchu olimpijskim. Obraz łączy w sobie formę klasycznego dokumentu z klipem bazującym na emocjach wiernych kibiców. Jest to sentymentalna podróż przez dzieje polskiego sportu z uwzględnieniem bohaterów, dzięki którym nasz kraj jest godnie reprezentowany na arenie międzynarodowej. Sprawnie zrealizowana opowieść przywodzi na myśl baśń czytaną wnukowi przez dziadka z pradawnej księgi.

programme.title: Piłka nożna: Liga hiszpańska - mecz: FC Barcelona - Real Madryt CF
programme.desc: Królewscy w poprzednim sezonie dali się zdystansować Dumie Katalonii na wszystkich frontach. FC Barcelona zdobyła mistrzostwo kraju, kończąc rozgrywki z dużą przewagą nad Realem Madryt. Pokonała odwiecznego rywala również w finałach Superpucharu Hiszpanii i Pucharu Króla. Ostatnie ligowe spotkanie na Santiago Bernabeu zakończyło się jednak wygraną ekipy ze stolicy 2:1. Przekonamy się, czy żądny rewanżu Real, który w obecnej kampanii nie prezentuje jednak zbyt efektownej gry, będzie w stanie powtórzyć ten wyczyn.

programme.title: Piłka nożna: PKO BP Ekstraklasa - mecz: Wisła Kraków - Śląsk Wrocław
programme.desc: Poprzednie spotkanie obu ekip wygenerowało mnóstwo emocji. Niestety, tylko tych negatywnych, a mecz dwóch walczących wówczas o awans do Ekstraklasy zespołów ostatecznie nie doszedł do skutku. Władze Śląska Wrocław uniemożliwiły wejście na stadion kibicom Wisły Kraków, a zarządzający Białą Gwiazdą Jarosław Królewski zadecydował, że w tej sytuacji jego piłkarze nie wyjdą na boisko. Tym razem o odwołaniu meczu nie może być mowy. Przekonamy się, jak Krakowianie przywitają gości po tamtych wydarzeniach.

programme.desc: Królewscy w poprzednim sezonie dali się zdystansować Dumie Katalonii na wszystkich frontach. FC Barcelona zdobyła mistrzostwo kraju, kończąc rozgrywki z dużą przewagą nad Realem Madryt. Pokonała odwiecznego rywala również w finałach Superpucharu Hiszpanii i Pucharu Króla. programme.desc: Programa semanal de 45 minutos dedicado às tendências e aos fenómenos da cultura pop. Televisão, cinema, literatura, música, redes sociais e plataformas digitais são analisados por quatro comentadores, numa conversa que procura explicar o que está a marcar o gosto, os hábitos e o debate cultural contemporâneo. programme.desc: Um jovem estudante de teatro recebe um convite de seu pai, que não conhece, para ir ter com ele a Angola. Na viagem, conhece uma estudante angolana que regressa ao seu país. Quando se dirige à morada do pai, depara-se com uma grande surpresa e a sua vida não será a mesma.

programme.title: A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Isaura nasceu em 1835, na fazenda do Comendador Almeida, fruto da relação de uma escrava negra com o feitor da fazenda. A mãe morre chicoteada num tronco, pelo que Isaura é criada por Gertrudes, mulher de Almeida. Mas, apesar da excelente educação e da pele muito clara, Isaura é escrava...

programme.title: Televendas
programme.desc: Todos os dias, um espaço dedicado a vendas por televisão, em que são feitas demonstrações dos produtos.

programme.title: 24 Horas
programme.desc: Bloco noticioso com um olhar para o dia que termina, marcando claramente a atualidade do novo dia que começa. Neste espaço de informação têm também destaque os principais eventos culturais do país, com as opiniões de quem os constrói e daqueles que estiveram na plateia.

programme.title: Bom Dia Portugal
programme.desc: Porque é de manhã que se começa o dia, então inicie-o na nossa companhia! Todos os dias, o «Bom dia Portugal» dedica espaços específicos às notícias da atualidade nacional e internacional, desporto, meteorologia, trânsito e economia.

programme.title: Praça da Alegria
programme.desc: Jorge Gabriel e Sónia Araújo dão-lhe as boas vindas à Praça da Alegria! Porque sabemos que gosta da nossa companhia, oferecemos boa disposição até à hora de almoço! De segunda a sexta-feira, a Praça da Alegria leva até si a melhor música, as últimas tendências da moda, conselhos úteis e muitas dicas que facilitam o seu dia-a-dia. Portugal inteiro marca presença nesta Praça da Alegria com reportagens e diretos onde ficamos mais perto de si!

programme.title: Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Todos os dias, às 13 horas, a sua hora de almoço é completada com a atualização das notícias que marcam a atualidade nacional e mundial, desde a política, a economia, a sociedade e sem esquecer o desporto. Reportagens no local, entrevistas em direto e sempre a isenção e o respeito pela verdade que marcam a informação na RTP.

programme.title: Hora da Sorte: Lotaria Clássica
programme.desc: Às segundas-feiras uma emissão especial que inclui a extração dos números da sorte da Lotaria Clássica.

programme.title: A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Isaura nasceu em 1835, na fazenda do Comendador Almeida, fruto da relação de uma escrava negra com o feitor da fazenda. A mãe morre chicoteada num tronco, pelo que Isaura é criada por Gertrudes, mulher de Almeida. Mas, apesar da excelente educação e da pele muito clara, Isaura é escrava...

programme.title: Negócio Fechado
programme.desc: "Negócio Fechado" mergulha no universo das antiguidades e colecionáveis, onde cada peça encerra histórias fascinantes e um valor por descobrir. Eduardo Alves Marques e Tânia Ribas de Oliveira guiam os telespectadores e proprietários na avaliação e exploração da origem dos objetos. Posteriormente, os donos negoceiam com um painel de compradores experientes, como Álvaro Roquette e Batata Cerqueira Gomes, num processo que promete intensa emoção e revelações históricas.

programme.title: Agarra-me Se Puderes
programme.desc: Agarra-me Se Puderes desafia concorrentes de todo o país a colocarem à prova os seus conhecimentos numa corrida contra o tempo pela conquista do prémio final. O concurso combina cultura geral e competição num formato divertido para toda a família, com o anfitrião José Pedro Vasconcelos.

programme.title: Portugal em Rede
programme.desc: O Portugal que existe para além das grandes cidades, do norte ao sul e às ilhas, numa verdadeira rede de informação. Inclui um segmento dedicado à língua portuguesa e à sua promoção "Esta língua que nos une". Os Centros de Informação Regional terão uma participação relevante neste espaço.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, "O Preço Certo", é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países. programme.title: Cinemax
programme.desc: Cinemax é um programa dedicado ao universo da curta-metragem e à relevância deste formato na descoberta de novos talentos e valorização de autores clássicos. O Cinemax garante a exibição regular de curtas-metragens, complementada por breves entrevistas que apresentam os seus autores.

programme.title: Na Sombra
programme.desc: Após a primeira volta, restam apenas dois candidatos na corrida: Guillaume Vital, que lidera, e Paul Francoeur. Este último tem de angariar o máximo de apoios políticos, mesmo que isso implique fazer concessões, e conter Trémeau, que se comporta como se já tivesse ganho. Caligny recupera as provas da fraude.

programme.title: Voz de Cama
programme.sub-title: Um Homem em Desconstrução, com Diana Nicolau
programme.desc: Um ouvinte está a tentar ser mais desconstruído, mas é gozado pelos amigos e sente que está a ser friendzoned.

programme.title: Madeira Profunda
programme.desc: Os lugares, o povo, as tradições, as particularidades escondidas de sítios da ilha da Madeira até agora pouco conhecidos. Ao longo de 12 episódios propomos dar a conhecer uma outra realidade deste arquipélago.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Gabinete de Curiosidades
programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: Index
programme.desc: Com duas temáticas diferentes por dia, o "Index" é um quizz que coloca o espectador à prova e ainda dá a conhecer várias curiosidades.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: O Sociedade Civil é um programa com História que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. São questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.title: Molang
programme.desc: Molang é uma série infantil com um olhar afetuoso e bem-humorado sobre a amizade entre um coelho excêntrico, alegre e entusiasta e Piu Piu, um pintainho tímido, discreto e sentimental.

programme.title: Cadetes
programme.desc: Os nossos amigos são cadetes espaciais, exploradores em formação numa academia espacial de uma escola de jogos no planeta WotWot. Nessa academia, os cinco amigos aprendem e brincam juntos, mas cada um tem uma área de interesse especial como arte ou ciência.

programme.title: Kiri e Lou
programme.desc: Numa floresta de papel recortado e com criaturas feitas de argila, Kiri, um pequeno dinossauro mal-humorado com emoções avassaladoras e Lou, uma criatura gentil e atenciosa, podem parecer os melhores amigos mais improváveis.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Jasmine e Jambo
programme.desc: Jasmine e Jambo são loucos por música. Eles vivem em Soundland, uma terra divertida e surreal onde a música e a vida andam de mãos dadas.

programme.title: Pirata & Capitão
programme.desc: Ser pirata e capitão é uma busca sem fim por tesouros, viver grandes aventuras, diversão e espírito de equipa.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: De Tóquio a Nova York, da Austrália a Madagáscar, passando pela Grécia, Mouk e Chavapa encontram habitantes de todo o planeta ... Traz a tua bicicleta e junta-te a estes amigos numa aventura à descoberta do mundo real, moderno e super colorido!

programme.title: A Ovelha Choné
programme.desc: Ovelha Choné? Pois esta ovelha é um pouco excêntrica, como o nome indica! Aventuras cheias de humor na quinta, sob a supervisão do Agricultor e de Bitzer, o cão pastor.

programme.title: Dinoster: Os Heróis Quânticos
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de quatro amigos que aparentam levar uma vida normal, mas viajam em segredo para a Dino Terra para estudar os dinossauros e salvá-los do perigo. É a equipa Dinoster!

programme.title: Minúsculo (5 Minutos)
programme.desc: Os nossos pequenos heróis de "Minúsculo" estão de volta com uma nova série de divertidas e surpreendentes aventuras. Desde o tranquilo campo e as montanhas envoltas em neve até às ruas de Paris e às praias ensolaradas, os nossos amigos insetos vêem-se envolvidos em situações repletas de comédia, ação, suspense e poesia. Combinando animação CGI com belíssimas paisagens filmadas ao vivo, "Minúsculo" conta as suas histórias com charme e humor, sem qualquer diálogo ou comentário.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Numa vasta reserva natural localizada no meio da floresta selvagem, há um pequeno núcleo de civilização humana: a casa do guarda-florestal.

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Todas as manhãs, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhãs chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhãs, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas histórias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de Leonel, uma mosca doméstica e filho do meio de muitos irmãos. Lloyd mora com os seus pais, a sua irmãzinha e os seus irmãos larvas dentro de um compostor a que chamam lar.

programme.title: As Aventuras de Ladybug
programme.desc: Marinette e Adrien durante o dia são dois adolescentes normais com uma vida normal, mas há uma coisa sobre eles que ainda ninguém sabe: quando algo ameaça a cidade, Marinette e Adrien transformam-se em Ladybug e Cat Noir!

programme.title: Zoe e Milo
programme.desc: Zoe e Milo são duas crianças de dez anos. Eles não são apenas vizinhos que vivem numa cidade grande, são os melhores amigos. E também são aventureiros: viajam pelo mundo num avião construído e pilotado por Alim, um hamster.

programme.title: Index
programme.desc: Com duas temáticas diferentes por dia, o "Index" é um quizz que coloca o espectador à prova e ainda dá a conhecer várias curiosidades.

programme.title: Europa à Porta
programme.desc: Com reportagens nas regiões de todo o país, vamos "abrir portas" e descobrir projetos nas áreas da sustentabilidade, saúde, inovação, migrações e cultura. A RTP vai percorrer Portugal e perceber para que servem os fundos europeus....

programme.title: Terra Europa
programme.desc: A série acompanha o trabalho dos eurodeputados e das instituições europeias como nunca antes visto, através de quatro novas rúbricas. Descomplicar a Europa com o "Dicionário Europeu". Construir a Europa, com a participação de jovens portugueses eleitores.

programme.title: Ensino: O Desafio do Superior em Portugal
programme.desc: Num mundo globalizado e em acelerada mudança tecnológica, deter conhecimento é fundamental para a robustez e competitividade de um país. Mas no caso de Portugal, a aposta massiva na educação não resultou, em termos genéricos, nem no aumento da produtividade nem do crescimento económico.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Sombras no Mar
programme.desc: Soldados liderados pelo Comandante Calderi invadem o porto de Fécamp. Com a ajuda de Jimmy e da sua equipa, Abigail tenta identificar a origem das perturbações eletromagnéticas no mar e do estranho brilho que Jimmy observou.

programme.title: A Vida Privada dos Livros
programme.desc: Série da autoria da jornalista Ana Daniela Soares e do bibliófilo internacionalmente reputado Alberto Manguel, sobre histórias de livros, de escritores e de leitores. Deambulando por alguns lugares de Lisboa, e não só, folheamos páginas que ligam os livros e a cidade a Dickens e muitos outros.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto
programme.desc: "Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto" é um programa da responsabilidade de Clara Almeida Santos, Provedora do Telespectador da RTP dedicado a dar voz ao público e a reforçar a transparência do serviço público de televisão. Num formato acessível e focado no rigor, "Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto" aproxima o serviço público dos cidadãos, esclarece, questiona e contribui para uma televisão mais transparente, diversa e responsável.

programme.title: O Mundo nos Açores
programme.desc: Pessoas, com modos de vida diferente, que se apaixonaram pelos Açores e aqui decidiram viver encontrando-se completamente integradas na sociedade Açoriana. É uma comunidade cada vez maior de cidadãos estrangeiros com residência nas diversas ilhas dos Açores, muitos deles criando empresas.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: O Sociedade Civil é um programa com História que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. São questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.title: Auga Seca
programme.desc: As últimas pistas encontradas pela polícia levam a crer que Paulo traficava armas. O que não podiam imaginar é que o negócio de Paulo era só uma pequena parte e que o verdadeiro traficante é Mauro, que acaba de descobrir que Paulo o roubava.

programme.title: Hotéis XXI
programme.desc: "Turista ou Viajante?" é uma tentativa de compreender o fundamento e evolução da viagem e criação de hotéis no século XXI, hotéis criados por pessoas vindas das mais diversas áreas com histórias que ajudam a estabelecer uma mudança de paradigma naquilo que se conhecia ser a hotelaria.

programme.title: Preto no Branco
programme.desc: A série "Preto no Branco" mergulha no arquivo da RTP desde 1957, revisitando a memória da televisão portuguesa em preto e branco. Sem comentários críticos, propõe uma reflexão sobre o Portugal da época, revelando como a estação via o país e, por vezes, muito mais do que aparentava. Descobrem-se tesouros esquecidos, o quotidiano, esforços de modernização e imagens inéditas, algumas digitalizadas especificamente para esta série, que iluminam a evolução da RTP e da nação.

programme.title: Gabinete de Curiosidades
programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Os Numberblocks são um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vão ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy persegue os Lemmings, que encheram uma jarra com Yummy e colocaram no seu carrinho de controle-remoto. Quando o urso chega ao posto de gasolina, ele destrói o veículo e recupera a barra de chocolate.

programme.title: Sericórnio: Chuva de Estrelas
programme.desc: Num mundo oceânico mágico, Astra e as suas amigas embarcam numa aventura para resgatar uma criatura com poderosa energia criativa, raptada pelo malvado Ika Inkblot, que pretende roubar toda a magia dos oceanos. Durante a jornada, as heroínas descobrem os seus poderes especiais e aprendem a importância da amizade e coragem. Com a ajuda de Kameko, uma humana transformada em Sericórnio, unem-se para proteger o mundo submarino e impedir a escuridão.

programme.title: Luke, o Viajante no Tempo
programme.desc: Luke é um rapaz que viaja para vários mundos e épocas diferentes dentro de um elevador muito especial: um elevador que viaja no tempo! Uma emocionante aventura com Luke está prestes a começar!

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de Leonel, uma mosca doméstica e filho do meio de muitos irmãos. Lloyd mora com os seus pais, a sua irmãzinha e os seus irmãos larvas dentro de um compostor a que chamam lar.

programme.title: Samuel
programme.desc: Samuel, um rapaz tímido de 10 anos começa a escrever um diário para processar os seus sentimentos, os primeiros amores, as amizades complexas e a transição da escola primária para o início da adolescência. Uma série de animação criada por Emilie Tronche.

programme.title: Dona da Casa
programme.desc: O sofrimento de pensar, o impacto das memórias familiares, as heranças emocionais e o trauma, a mulher como ser sexual, a cultura do corpo e o feminicídio no Brasil, os padrões da política, a saúde mental hoje, o desejo.

programme.title: Visita Guiada
programme.desc: Em 1130, Coimbra torna-se o centro da expansão de D. Afonso Henriques contra os muçulmanos. A carência de recursos do Condado Portucalense é colmatada por um casamento estratégico, viabilizando a conquista de Lisboa. A última campanha militar de D. Afonso Henriques, em Badajoz, marca o fim do seu reinado expansionista. Esta é a terceira etapa de uma viagem pela vida do rei, guiada pelo medievalista Luís Carlos Amaral.

programme.title: The Daily Show
programme.desc: A conjugação do humor com as notícias, a sátira política e da indústria dos media no geral, blocos de reportagens, diretos e entrevistas a personalidades políticas ou a celebridades de Hollywood.

programme.title: Jornal 2
programme.desc: O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciência, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: A Guerra dos Mundos
programme.desc: Após a "vitória", é revelada a verdadeira história do que aconteceu.

programme.title: Feita de Fogo
programme.desc: Googoosh, pioneira e ícone da pop iraniana dos anos 70, viu a sua carreira interrompida em 1980 pelo regime de Khomeini, sendo proibida de atuar e passando 20 anos em prisão domiciliária. Após um surpreendente regresso internacional em 2000, a sua história tornou-se um símbolo de esperança e resistência na luta iraniana pela liberdade. A sua voz, que combinou poesia persa com vários géneros ocidentais, ecoou novamente em solidariedade com a jovem geração após a morte de Mahsa Amini.

Magda, irmã de Gabriel, que joga basquetebol, acaba de conquistar uma vaga na equipa de elite da cidade, o Taelgia. Sibel muda-se e torna-se a primeira agente síria em Sodertalje.

programme.desc: Os portugueses vivem cada vez mais anos, têm cada vez menos filhos e existe a necessidade de uma imigração cada vez mais qualificada. Esta realidade demográfica implica adaptações urgentes que melhorem o bem-estar das populações, mas também enormes desafios para o futuro da economia nacional.

programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Sombras no Mar
programme.desc: Abigail descobre uma criatura desconhecida enquanto mergulha na baía de Fécamp, que se recusa a abandonar a sua cria morta, presa nas redes de pesca. Enquanto a cidade fala de um monstro, o marinheiro Pierre planeia capturá-lo.

programme.title: Preto no Branco
programme.desc: "Preto no Branco" revisita os arquivos da RTP desde 1957, explorando a televisão a preto e branco e a sua memória ligada ao regime. Os episódios, intemporais, agem como aforismos, mostrando o passado português sem crítica, convidando o espectador à contextualização. A série revela tesouros esquecidos, da pobreza à modernização, momentos singulares e o trabalho pioneiro dos profissionais da RTP, com imagens inéditas e digitalizadas.

programme.title: A Vida Privada dos Livros
programme.desc: Série da autoria da jornalista Ana Daniela Soares e do bibliófilo internacionalmente reputado Alberto Manguel, sobre histórias de livros, de escritores e de leitores. Deambulando por alguns lugares de Lisboa, e não só, folheamos páginas que ligam os livros e a cidade a Dickens e muitos outros.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Pontos & Cardeais
programme.desc: Esta semana exploramos Vila Pouca de Aguiar, um concelho transmontano no distrito de Vila Real, repleto de História e paisagens grandiosas. Com raízes ligadas às origens de Portugal, oferece colinas verdes, rios, águas termais e sabores locais. A sua ruralidade autêntica e património idílico respiram tradição e natureza, onde se encontra a genuinidade das suas gentes de sorriso aberto.

programme.desc: Após sofrer um ataque na sede da sua empresa em Luanda, Mauro vê-se obrigado a retomar o envio das armas aos seus clientes em África.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: 10 Mil Km, de Regresso ao Japão
programme.desc: O que podem ter em comum dois países tão distantes quanto o Japão e Portugal? Na verdade, há um intercâmbio de 500 anos para descobrir, que se revela na gastronomia, nos objetos, na moda ou na linguagem.

programme.title: Gabinete de Curiosidades
programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: Eurobasket Feminino 2027 - 2ª Fase de Qualificação - Dinamarca x Portugal
programme.desc: Portugal integra o Grupo N de qualificação para o EuroBasket Feminino 2027, enfrentando Alemanha, Hungria e Dinamarca. As duas primeiras de cada grupo avançam. A equipa nacional inicia fora de portas contra a Dinamarca e a Hungria em novembro, culminando com o primeiro jogo em casa a 17 de novembro, em Odivelas, frente à Alemanha. Este regresso ao público português é crucial para o objetivo de apuramento num grupo exigente.

programme.title: Liga Extraordinária
programme.desc: Começou a sua carreira de FC Porto, tornando-se aos 13 anos campeã nacional dos 3000 metros e mais tarde torna-se campeã europeia na mesma distância. Campeã do Mundo e da Europa, Fernanda Ribeiro teve o seu apogeu em 1996 nos Jogos Olímpicos de Atlanta com a conquista da medalha de ouro.

programme.title: UEFA Liga dos Campeões Feminina - Benfica x Áustria Viena (Direto)
programme.desc: A Seleção Nacional Feminina de Basquetebol integra o Grupo N da qualificação para o próximo EuroBasket, defrontando Alemanha, Hungria e Dinamarca. Portugal começa a sua jornada fora, com desafios perante a Dinamarca e a Hungria, antes de receber a Alemanha em Odivelas, num esperado regresso a casa. Cada resultado é vital para alcançar o objetivo de qualificação neste grupo exigente.

programme.title: Jornal 2

programme.title: Famílias como a Nossa
programme.desc: O aumento do nível da água já não pode ser ignorado, e o governo decide evacuar a Dinamarca. Acompanhamos Laura, de 19 anos, e a sua família quando a notícia é divulgada.

programme.title: Um Mundo Dividido
programme.desc: Em 1944, a física Joan Hinton, do Projeto Manhattan, testemunha o teste nuclear que leva a Hiroshima e Nagasaki, confrontando-a com o custo da vitória. Enquanto isso, o soldado Frantz Fanon questiona a sua luta face à discriminação, e a nacional-socialista Hedwig Hoess, em fuga dos soviéticos, defronta-se com uma escolha brutal no rescaldo da Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: A Guerra dos Tronos - A Verdadeira História da Europa
programme.desc: Henrique IV é o novo rei da França. Mas sendo protestante, poucos aceitam vê-lo usar a coroa. Em abril de 1590, o rei e as suas tropas, 21 000 homens, chegam às portas de Paris. A poderosa Liga Católica, que conta com o dobro dos homens, impede-o de entrar na capital para assumir o trono.

programme.title: Vencidos

programme.desc: Num mágico mundo oceânico, Astra e as amigas embarcam numa aventura para resgatar uma criatura com energia criativa, raptada por Ika Inkblot, que anseia roubar toda a magia marinha. As heroínas desvendam os seus poderes, superam desafios e aprendem sobre amizade e coragem. Com a ajuda de Kameko, uma humana transformada em Sericórnio, unem-se para proteger o mundo subaquático e impedir que a escuridão destrua a sua magia ancestral.

programme.title: Sim, Eu Consigo
programme.desc: Conjunto de documentários de vários países em que crianças e jovens narram a sua vida e se propõem a cumprir um desafio. Ao longo de cada documentário ficamos a saber onde vivem, como é a sua família e quais são os seus sonhos.

programme.title: Agenda Zigzaguear
programme.desc: Todas as semanas trazemos propostas de atividades culturais para crianças e famílias de Norte a Sul do país. Sugerimos espetáculos de teatro, música, cinema, exposições, oficinas e muito mais. Uma agenda inteiramente dedicada aos mais pequenos!

programme.title: Samuel
programme.desc: Samuel, um rapaz tímido de 10 anos começa a escrever um diário para processar os seus sentimentos, os primeiros amores, as amizades complexas e a transição da escola primária para o início da adolescência. Uma série de animação criada por Emilie Tronche.

programme.title: Refeitório
programme.desc: Um programa de conversas em torno do que é a Gastronomia com G maiúsculo, substantivada e rica, mas não apenas sobre a qualidade do prato já terminado e pronto a comer. Em cada programa, o Refeitório de Joana Barrios serve um menu exclusivo, pensado para e por uma pessoa diferente capaz de nos encher o tabuleiro de histórias.

programme.title: O Elogio da Luz
programme.desc: Jardins bem iluminados ampliam a extensão da casa e alegram a vida dos seus moradores. Quando no escuro, transformam-se em verdadeiros buracos negros, impedem a visão do paisagismo e comprometem a sensação de segurança.

programme.title: Miguel Ângelo: Escândalo na Capela Sistina
programme.desc: O documentário de Frédéric Biamonti explora a censura de 1563 ao "Juízo Final" de Miguel Ângelo, devido aos seus nus impactantes. Este evento marcou uma luta entre liberdade artística e autoridade eclesiástica, revelando as tensões do Renascimento. A obra de Miguel Ângelo, ao desafiar tabus, expôs um poder religioso subtil e iniciou a censura artística, oferecendo uma nova leitura sobre esta obra icónica e a história da repressão católica.

programme.title: The Daily Show

programme.title: Famílias como a Nossa
programme.desc: Todos esperam que Jacob salve toda a família alargada, exceto Fanny, que não quer ser um fardo. Laura e Elias estão a ficar cada vez mais próximos.

programme.title: As Vozes do Sahara: Juntos Contra a Seca
programme.desc: Justine e Thomas documentam, numa viagem de bicicleta de oito meses de Paris a Dakar, as soluções ecológicas das comunidades do Saara face às alterações climáticas. A série de dois episódios explora a resiliência à seca na Tunísia e Argélia, e a sustentabilidade habitacional em Marrocos e no Senegal, destacando os esforços regionais para preservar a habitabilidade.

programme.title: Deus e Ciência
programme.desc: A origem da consciência é um enigma científico, debatendo-se se resulta de processos neuronais ou de uma realidade externa, com o cérebro como recetor. Experiências de quase-morte sugerem a sua independência da atividade cerebral. Investigadores exploram a física quântica como ponte entre uma consciência universal e o cérebro, através de canais iónicos nos neurónios. A física quântica revela uma realidade imaterial que reforça esta hipótese.

programme.title: A Doce Costa Leste
programme.desc: Uma adolescente insatisfeita, como uma "Alice na Wondermerica" desenfreada, embarca numa surreal e pitoresca viagem pela costa leste dos Estados Unidos. Nesta jornada iniciática, que é um road-movie e um filme de amadurecimento, Lillian depara-se com segredos obscuros, cultos extremistas e personagens fascinantes. Esta sátira vibrante e anarquista da América contemporânea assinala a estreia na realização do aclamado diretor de fotografia Sean Price Williams.

Moto Gp Sprint Race Mp Al Qatarului
Moto Gp Mp Al Qatarului – Rider Fun Parade / Warm Up
Elisa
Elisa di Rivombrosa
programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din
păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria
celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa
şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi
găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor
sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi
triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In the near future, Australian cop Max Rockatansky tires of battling to impose law and order on the roads and turns in his badge - only to be forced out of retirement when his wife and child are murdered at the hands of a motorcycle gang. George Miller's action thriller, starring Mel Gibson, Joanne Samuel and Hugh Keays-Byrne.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: A former cop haunted by his tragic past roams the wasteland of Australia in the aftermath of a nuclear war. He arrives at a besieged settlement and grudgingly helps protect the residents from a horde of marauding bikers who want to get hold of their valuable supply of petrol. Futuristic adventure sequel, starring Mel Gibson, Bruce Spence, Vernon Wells, Emil Minty and Kjell Nilsson.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: The nomadic warrior pitches up in the city of a cut-throat desert community in search of his stolen vehicle and ends up making a deal with a local dictator to get rid of her rival for power. However, when the bargain turns sour, he is cast out into the wilderness - where he becomes the unlikely protector of a tribe of feral youngsters. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Mel Gibson, Tina Turner and Bruce Spence.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: A soldier of fortune joins an academic and her conniving brother on an expedition to an ancient Egyptian lost city. The explorers accidentally cause the spirit of a vengeful priest with awe-inspiring supernatural powers to rise from his tomb, leading to a desperate battle for survival. Fantasy action adventure, starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo and Oded Fehr.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Married explorers Rick and Evelyn battle the newly resurrected mummy Imhotep and his ruthless partner, who have captured their son. The undead creature is heading for a confrontation with a legendary ancient warrior - with power over a magical army to be won. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo, Oded Fehr and Patricia Velasquez, with a brief appearance by Dwayne Johnson.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: A ruthless warlord resolves to rid the desert of its few remaining tribes, prompting them to seek the help of a legendary assassin to end the despot's reign of terror by destroying his source of power - a beautiful but deadly sorceress. Fantasy action adventure, starring Dwayne Johnson, Steven Brand, Kelly Hu and Michael Clarke Duncan.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Daredevil explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are called into action when their son accidentally resurrects the evil Chinese Emperor Han from his ancient tomb. The family now faces a race against time to prevent the merciless leader from awakening his vast terracotta army in a plot to take over the world. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello, Jet Li and Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Secret agents suspect there is a traitor in their organisation when their latest assignment ends in disaster. The sole survivor is accused of being the mole, forcing him to go on the run to clear his name. However, in the process, he discovers a former Russian spy is selling information about the world's leading undercover operatives. Action thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Cruise, Jon Voight and Ving Rhames.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt is sent to find and destroy the only sample of a deadly man-made virus. However, he faces tough opposition in a former spy-turned-criminal mastermind who has already acquired the cure and now wants the pathogen itself. Director John Woo's action thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Dougray Scott, Thandiwe Newton and Anthony Hopkins.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Former secret agent Ethan Hunt is called out of retirement when an ex-trainee is taken hostage by a ruthless arms dealer, but when the rescue operation goes wrong, the villain decides to target Hunt's fiancee. Action thriller sequel directed by JJ Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt and his team are implicated in a bombing at the Kremlin, forcing the American president to declare them fugitives. The spies plan to clear their name by abducting the real terrorist, which leads them into a pursuit around the globe. However, Hunt cannot be sure his colleagues are trustworthy. Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula Patton.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: The team of secret agents faces being shut down when the head of the CIA convinces the US Senate that it is too dangerous. The operatives of the Impossible Mission Force become fugitives when they defy orders and plot to bring down a shadowy society of assassins. Spy thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Rebecca Ferguson and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster caused by mysterious arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles. However, Hunt and his colleagues are soon pushed to their limits thanks to a face from their past. Writer/director Christopher McQuarrie's sixth entry in the action thriller saga, starring Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Rebecca Ferguson.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is in exile with both halves of the 3D cruciform key that can unlock the source code of rogue AI creation, the Entity. Hunt returns to London to reunite with Luther Stickell, Benji Dunn and former thief Grace. The Entity's human henchman, Gabriel, is still on the loose, so Hunt bolsters his ranks with vengeful French assassin Paris and US intelligence agent Theo Degas. Action thriller, starring Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Esai Morales.

But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Zack Mayo (Richard Gere), a new member of the U.S. Navy, has a bad attitude. When he signs up for the Aviation Academy, he is met with the strict leadership of Sgt. Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life.

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: John Gustafson (Jack Lemmon) and Max Goldman (Walter Matthau) are two curmudgeonly neighbors who have been at each other's throats for years. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?

While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Racing With the Moon
programme.desc: In their last weeks before deployment to World War II as Marines, teenage friends Henry Nash (Sean Penn) and Nicky (Nicolas Cage) try to make the best of the time they have left in their small California town. When Nash spots Caddie Winger (Elizabeth McGovern), a new girl in town he mistakenly believes to be wealthy, he sets about winning her over. But the good times are ruined when Nicky finds himself trying to solve a serious predicament, and implicating Nash and Caddie in the process.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds.

programme.title: You Can Count on Me
programme.desc: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt.

programme.title: Jimmy Kimmel Live!
programme.desc: Emmy-winning funnyman Jimmy Kimmel serves up comedy bits and welcomes guests that include other comics, celebrities, athletes and musicians, as well as everyday people with unusual or compelling personal stories. Kimmel's family and friends take part in the festivities, including his Cousin Sal, Uncle Frank (until his death in 2011) and childhood friend Cleto Escobedo III, who leads the show's house band. Recurring segments include the FCC-pleasing This Week in Unnecessary Censorship in which they take TV clips and "bleep and blur things whether they need it or not," as Kimmel describes it. But it's too bad they consistently run out of time for Matt Damon's segment.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: Greatest American Hero
programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: Eric Sloane (Dennis Alexio) is an American kickboxing pro, helped by his brother, Kurt (Jean-Claude Van Damme), in his quest for glory. But when the two go to Thailand to take on legendary Tong Po (Michel Qissi), the opponent viciously beats Eric and leaves him paralyzed. Swearing vengeance, Kurt tracks down master Xian Chow (Dennis Chan) and begins learning the sport himself while also getting caught up in criminal intrigue involving thuggish crime boss Freddy Li (Ka Ting Lee).

programme.title: Money Talks
programme.desc: Reporter James (Charlie Sheen) brings petty crook Franklin (Chris Tucker) to justice, but as Franklin is being taken to jail, he is unwittingly drawn into a violent prison break. The police pursue Franklin, mistakenly thinking he killed several officers, so the fugitive turns to James for help. Figuring he has stumbled upon the story of a lifetime, the journalist agrees to prove that Franklin is innocent. Unfortunately, things don't go smoothly, and both men find themselves on the run.

programme.desc: Retired from the Air Force, Chappy Sinclair (Lou Gossett Jr.) now runs a private flight school that happens to cater to misfits and juvenile offenders. programme.title: Brother, Can You Spare a Dime?
programme.desc: The Great Depression, in both its bleak lows and its artistic highs, is presented in this documentary. Featuring the grim reality that many Americans faced during the era, largely in the form of newsreel clips, the film also depicts how Hollywood dealt with this period of widespread poverty and unemployment. Much of the movie footage showcases glamour and extravagance, providing lively moments of escapism that contrast starkly with day-to-day life during the 1930s.

On board the same flight is Mark Sheridan (Wesley Snipes), a federal prisoner accused of double murder, who escapes during the ensuing chaos, but not before rescuing several people from the wreckage. Gerard is ordered to hunt down the fugitive along with State Department agent John Royce (Robert Downey Jr.), and the two pursue Sheridan relentlessly, despite growing doubts about his guilt.

programme.title: The Pianist
programme.desc: In this adaptation of the autobiography "The Pianist: The Extraordinary True Story of One Man's Survival in Warsaw, 1939-1945," Wladyslaw Szpilman, a Polish Jewish radio station pianist, sees Warsaw change gradually as World War II begins. Szpilman is forced into the Warsaw Ghetto, but is later separated from his family during Operation Reinhard. From this time until the concentration camp prisoners are released, Szpilman hides in various locations among the ruins of Warsaw.

programme.title: Bogus
programme.desc: A car accident leaves young Albert (Haley Joel Osment) orphaned, so he goes to live in New Jersey with Harriet (Whoopi Goldberg), who was his late mother's adopted sister. When the two of them have trouble getting along, Albert copes by befriending Bogus (Gérard Depardieu), a friendly, caring French magician who happens to be a figment of his mind. This new companion helps the youth come to terms with the loss of his parents -- but also, unexpectedly, helps Harriet confront her own feelings.

programme.title: Boys on the Side
programme.desc: After breaking up with her girlfriend, a nightclub singer, Jane (Whoopi Goldberg), answers a personal ad from Robin (Mary-Louise Parker), a real estate agent with AIDS, seeking a cross-country travel partner. On their journey from New York City to Los Angeles, the two stop by Pittsburgh to pick up Robin's friend Holly (Drew Barrymore), who is trying to escape an abusive relationship. With three distinct personalities, the women must overcome their differences to help one another.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: Oath of Vengeance
programme.desc: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Bar 20 Justice
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing.

programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In Marriage, Dr. Mark Sandoval examines God’s original design for marriage through the unchanging Law of Life. Established before the Fall, marriage was never intended to function as a relationship of dependency between spouses, but as a cooperative union in which both husband and wife take their needs from God and give unselfishly to one another. This episode clarifies marriage as a lifelong, covenant relationship with purpose—not an end in itself, but a means through which God’s will is accomplished. Dr. Sandoval addresses common distortions surrounding vows, accountability, authority, submission, intimacy, communication, and divorce, showing how each becomes destructive when spouses replace God as their source. Grounded in Scripture, the presentation restores marriage to its sacred role as a reflection of Christ and the church, an instrument for character development, and a blessing to family and society. Viewers are invited to reexamine their understanding of marriage and return to God’s original purpose as the foundation for lasting unity and love.

programme.desc: Daniel was given great prophetic visions; so astonishing at times, that made him very ill. He was shown highlights of this world’s kingdoms from his time up through the second coming of Christ. An angel had instructed Daniel that some of what he had been shown was to be “shut up and sealed unto the time of the end.” And during this “ time of the end,” he was shown that knowledge would increase. Certainly, looking back, we can attest that knowledge has increased, but what about the “time of the end”? Has that time begun? How important are the prophetic books of Daniel and Revelation? Has the book of Daniel already been UNSEALED? And what hope do we have for the future? Please stay study along with Pastor Kenny Shelton as he shares the answers to these questions during this message entitled, “ Prophecies UNSEALED: Hope for the Future!”.

programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: Biblical prophets often delivered messages people did not want to hear, yet God’s truth was never optional or negotiable. This program explores why prophetic instruction was given for the protection, correction, and salvation of God’s people. Discover how Scripture records both faithful responses and tragic rebellion when divine counsel confronted human error. Through biblical examples, we learn that God’s Word remains the standard of truth, especially in an age of competing personal beliefs. Prophetic messages may challenge us, but faithfully received, they provide lifesaving guidance for God’s people even today.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: Noah explores The Mammoth Site in Hot Springs, South Dakota. He’ll explore this amazing site, where over one hundred mammoths have been preserved in the sediments in an ancient sinkhole. He’ll find out how genetics can explain where the mammoths came from after the global Flood, why radio carbon dating can only give us accurate dates of a few thousand years, and how they could have reproduced so quickly after coming off the ark. Finally, he’ll explore how the Ice Age, caused by the global Flood, would have come and gone quickly, causing the right conditions to force the mammoths into extinction.

programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: The vintage sci-fi comic strip character gets a 21st-century makeover in this freewheeling adaptation that sends All-American track star Steven "Flash" Gordon on a series of wild adventures that begins when he falls through an interdimensional rift in space and lands on the planet Mongo, accompanied by his old flame from high school, Dale Arden. Flash is looking for clues to the fate of his father, the eminent scientist Dr. Lawrence Gordon, previously believed to have died in a laboratory fire several years earlier. His quest, however, leads him into the clutches of Ming, the evil ruler of Mongo, and his devious daughter, Aura. Flash escapes back to Earth, vowing to foil the ruthless Ming's threat to humanity. Fortunately, in addition to Dale, Flash can count on help from Baylin, a beautiful but tough intergalactic bounty hunter, and Hans Zarkov, the eccentric former associate of Flash's father.

programme.title: Crooked House

programme.title: Heart Wise Ministries - The Heart of Health
programme.desc: The Heart of Health is a call in health program providing viewers with an opportunity to call in and get free medical advice from guests who practice medicine every day.

programme.title: It Is Written Canada
programme.desc: Mike and René Lemon are the hosts for It Is Written Canada, a nationwide television ministry that spotlights the life-transforming power of trusting God’s Word.

programme.title: Remodeling Your Life - Talking Donkey Int.
programme.desc: Discover what has been misunderstood by many for centuries… it’s not about us, rather, It’s all about God. God is the solution — the only One who can lift us up, change our lives and give us victory. Shot in multiple states and more than 90 locations, this series unpacks the key to what the book of Revelation calls, overcoming.

programme.title: Watch and Pray at Midnight
programme.desc: Are we living in the "Midnight Hour" referenced in the parable of Matthew 24 and 25? Looking at events taking place around us we can see the approaching crisis. This series will cover different crises affecting the world and what it can teach us about God and our need for a refinement.

programme.title: SUMtv Stories
programme.desc: SUMtv sits down with church members and ministry leaders as they share their testimonies of hope, redemption, and spiritual growth.

programme.title: Three Angels Made Practical
programme.desc: We may have the theological understanding of the Three Angels Messages but do we understand how to make these messages practical and relevant to our lives? In this ten-part series Lo-ammi Richardson will go text-by-text to help break down the commands to fear God, give glory, and worship Him.

programme.title: Last Generation Theology
programme.sub-title: The Assurance of Salvation and Last Generation Theology
programme.desc: What is Last Generation Theology? Very likely you've heard this phrase in the church during the past few years. Is it an anti-gospel, legalistic heresy, as some have alleged? Or is it the Bible-based rationale for the existence, message, and mission of the Seventh-day Adventist movement? The purpose of this symposium is to take these questions to the Bible and the writings of the Spirit of Prophecy to discover God's answers.

programme.title: Anchor 2026: The Minor Prophets
programme.sub-title: The Origin and Demise of the Jewish Theocracy - Part 1

programme.title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
programme.sub-title: The Great Multitude and the 144,000: Explained
programme.desc: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

programme.title: It Is Written - with John Bradshaw
programme.desc: It Is Written is the flagship program of the It Is Written ministry, which for more than six decades has shared the transforming teachings of the Bible directly from the pages of God’s Word. Presented by Pastor John Bradshaw and often filmed in fascinating and visually stunning locations around the world, It Is Written covers a wide range of Biblical subjects and shares faith in Jesus Christ as the hope of the world.

programme.title: Timeless Healing Insights - Revelation
programme.desc: The book of Revelation has a surprising secret to rest at its very heart. Learn why most of the world will miss out on it.

programme.title: God's Principles for Healthy Relationships - Season 2
programme.sub-title: Unspoken Expectations Can Destroy Your Relationships
programme.desc: Whether you're navigating the complexities of creating relationships or seeking to deepen or mend your current relationships, this series provides invaluable wisdom for a true love and healing that lasts. Drawing from biblical principles and practical strategies, certified Life and Relationship coaches Martin and Debbie Raj share their journey, promoting forgiveness, values, self-worth and joy in Jesus. They address the prevalence of broken families and relationships marred by abusive behaviors, identity crises, lack of leadership, commitment and genuine love. They firmly believe that Happily Ever After is not a myth, but a reality attainable through following God's plan and committing to the necessary effort, with the belief that “In His presence, there is fullness of Joy.” Psalm 16:11. Join us in this transformative journey to enrich your life and your relationships, one episode at a time.

programme.title: Mission Revival - Outpost Centers International
programme.desc: Hosted by Steve Dickman and Michelle Song, this series brings to light the desperate need for outreach in all areas of the world. While Seventh-day Adventism has made it's mark, there are still areas of the world that have yet to be touched. This series will provide you with helpful ministry tips and inspiring testimonies of those who have answered the call to outreach ministry. "And the Good News about the Kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, so that all nations will hear it; and then the end will come.." (Matthew 24:14).

programme.title: Divine Design
programme.desc: From expectant parents and grandparents to health and childbirth educators, or anyone who questions creation in this modern evolution-driven world, these Christ-centered episodes by Patti Barnes will lead you to give glory to our Creator as they demonstrate a sample of the Divine wisdom and power in human reproduction.

programme.title: Cracking The Genesis Code
programme.desc: On the surface the book of Genesis appears to be a mere collection of ancient stories. But don't be fooled! Beneath the external simplicity lies a secret code which, when broken, reveals in no uncertain terms what will happen in the future. This series reveals the intimate connection between the first book of the Bible, Genesis, and the last book, Revelation. Don't miss this life changing experience!

programme.title: Jesus for Asia Faith Camp
programme.desc: With every missionary stepping into the mission field, stories and miracles are bound to happen! Join us in this inspiring series as missionaries working with Jesus For Asia share those amazing stories and miracles! Whether you're looking for inspiration, a boost of faith, or simply a good story, this series will leave you moved and motivated.

programme.title: Unsealed Insights
programme.desc: Secrets Unsealed Ministry quarterly update program takes a look at how God has been moving through the ministry. Featuring updates from our pastoral department, testimonies from the field, new media projects, and upcoming initiatives — all designed to inform, inspire, and invite you to become part of the mission.

programme.title: The End of Religion
programme.desc: The End of Religion is a cinematic documentary series that uncovers the hidden truths behind organized religion. In the series, Vincent embarks on a global journey to uncover why religion has caused so much evil in the world—only to stumble upon a shocking discovery that changes everything.

programme.title: Adverum Productions - Journeys
programme.sub-title: Miikael's Journey: from Party Animal to Missionary
programme.desc: Growing up in secular Estonia gave Miikael only a very faint idea of what Christianity is, which steadily turned into a deep dislike. He is a thoroughly skeptical agnostic, who lives for parties, drinking and motorcycling. A chance brush with the dark world of spirits seeds the idea of the existence of a higher power. Armed with a Bible and some bottles of wine, Miikael sets out to investigate the deeper questions of life. What comes out at the other end is not what his friends and family expected. Follow one man’s journey to faith and the twists and turns that shaped it.

programme.title: It Is Written Canada
programme.desc: Mike and René Lemon are the hosts for It Is Written Canada, a nationwide television ministry that spotlights the life-transforming power of trusting God’s Word.

programme.title: White Horse Media - Fact Or Fiction
programme.sub-title: Founders Compared Part 5 and Post Death Scene Pt 2
programme.desc: “God: Fact or Fiction?” is a fascinating 14-part series featuring Subodh Pandit, MD that explores the Big Bang, evolution, science, the existence of God, and the claims of religion. Intellectually honest. Engaging. Challenging. It will keep you on the edge of your seat!

programme.title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
programme.sub-title: Why Is God Seen As Male?
programme.desc: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

programme.title: The Unknown God
programme.desc: The Unknown God is a thought-provoking series that dives deep into the Gospel of John to uncover the true characer of God; challenging common misconceptions and misinterpretations. Many believe they know God, but often these perceptions are built on surface-level knowledge or negative past experiences, leaving the true essense of His nature obscured. We invite you to join Dale Leamon in this series and discover enlightening insights on God's pure love, justice and mercy.

programme.title: Living Well
programme.desc: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? When we honor our bodies by fueling them with the natural God-given foods presented in the Bible, we feel capable to carry out the mission God has for our lives. This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!

programme.title: Mind Body Health Connections
programme.desc: The brain and body have been designed to work together as a “relay team” that powerfully affects mood, depression, anxiety, weight, immune health, and addictions. Discover “keystone” brain-gut strategies for building solid mental, physical, and spiritual health, for good!

programme.title: Anchor 2018: The End-Time Dimensions of the Parables
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and to provide the theological skills to share their new found hope and knowledge with others.

programme.title: Prophetic Secrets of the New World Order
programme.desc: Explore the incredible prophecies of the Bible that reveal secret principles behind the new world order and its destiny. Who will control the new globalization? Discover the secret of how to live in a globalized world without compromising your principles.

programme.title: His Way Is in the Sanctuary
programme.desc: One writer once stated: “The correct understanding of the ministration in the heavenly sanctuary is the foundation of our faith. ” (EV 221). But why is this so? What makes the doctrine of the sanctuary so important?In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service.
