programme.sub-title: Principio #15 Aprenda a usar el Espíritu de Profecía en relación con La Biblia Parte 1
programme.desc: En esta serie de temas el Pastor Bohr explica en minucioso detalle los métodos de estudio que debemos usar al estudiar las profecías. La serie no es primordialmente una interpretación de las profecías sino más bien un método para estudiarlas e interpretarlas correctamente. Usted mismo aprenderá a estudiar e interpretar las profecías usando métodos que le llevaran a conclusiones acertadas. Vivimos en tiempos proféticos y necesitamos explicar en forma clara y sencilla a dónde estamos en la gran cadena profética y cuáles eventos pronto estallarán en el escenario mundial. Esta serie es el resultado de años de investigación. Al aplicar estos 15 principios, usted mismo podrá entender y exponer las profecías con claridad y poder.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Mutated graboids return to feast on the residents of Perfection, threatening its new status as a tourist attraction.","large":"Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: A New Yorker living with four models falls for a neighbor who may be a murderer.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.","large":"A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: A recently divorced woman (Amy Poehler) and her hotheaded sister (Tina Fey) throw a party that spirals out of control at their childhood home.","large":"When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.","large":"Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Sent by an evil queen (Charlize Theron) to capture an escaped princess (Kristen Stewart), a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) instead becomes the young woman's protector and helps her in her quest to regain control of her kingdom.","large":"Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.","large":"Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.","large":"Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: After his son is tricked into awakening a cursed Chinese emperor, Rick O'Connell and his family seek a way to send the megalomaniac and his 10,000 warriors back to their graves.","large":"Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy and his team face an underworld prince who plans to awaken a lethal army and use it to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred.","large":"Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: Paranoia spreads among a team of Arctic researchers as they battle a deadly alien organism that assumes the shapes of its victims.","large":"After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: A wealthy family is held hostage for harboring the target of a murderous syndicate during the Purge, a 12-hour period in which any and all crime is legal.","large":"In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.","large":"As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.","large":"A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Hard Target

programme.title: Dracula

However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Engine Masters

programme.title: Engine Masters

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys demonstrate how improved airflow on a small motor equals pure RPM.

programme.title: Engine Masters

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Exhaust for Turbos - The Dos and Dont's
programme.desc: The crew tries to find the right balance of decibel levels and performance.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: It's a battle of price vs. power for street-centric wedge cylinder heads.

programme.title: Engine Masters

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Choosing Fuel: Which Barrel Is Right for You?

programme.title: Engine Masters

programme.desc: The guys explore the cooling benefits of water-methanol injection.

programme.title: Engine Masters

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Nitrous for Noobs - The 150 Shot Walkthrough
programme.desc: Using a basic 150-horse plate system, the crew demonstrates the basics on installation, safety and tuning for a typical carbureted engine.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We explore the differences between single and split-duration camshafts.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Testing intake upgrades for a street car swap; pitting the factory manifold against a worked-up aftermarket piece.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: The Piston Pin Offset Flip -- Is It a Flop?
programme.desc: The guys perform what may be the first ever back-to-back comparison of factory-oriented pistons against reverse-oriented pistons.

programme.title: Engine Masters

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: A Crash Course in Valve Float
programme.desc: Some know valve float as the evil that lurks beyond the redline, the dreaded robber of horsepower and destroyer of valves; taking a look at the valve float.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The team tears into a 1962 Chevy truck; Joe Martin plans to create a radical custom lowrider that scrapes the ground; improvements include a new air-ride suspension, tray, front end and paint job.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe has big plans for a 1964 Lincoln Continental, but a faulty steering column and a close call in the shop threaten to turn the flip into a never-ending money pit.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe and the gang turn a 1953 Ford Ranch Wagon into a mean beach cruiser; an accident occurs in the shop; the race is on to repaint a client's custom-built bike.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe and the team work on a 1973 Pontiac Firebird that was damaged by fire; a waterlogged engine puts the brakes on the build.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The team tackles a custom Softail from the ground up; Shag and Amanda discover a 1947 International milk truck in need of repair; a customer brings in a 1955 Chevy race car.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe believes that wide wheels and a killer paint job will attract customers to a 1964 Cadillac Coupe DeVille convertible, but hidden rust on the vehicle threatens to spoil his planned improvements.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Martin Bros. Customs prepares to transform a 1970 Chevy C10 into an autocross hot rod; Shag and Amanda desperately search for a sturdy cab for the build.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A 1935 Chevrolet Master rolls into the shop; made famous by the gangsters of its time, the vehicle features a distinctive grill, wood interior and "suicide doors.".

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A weather-beaten 1959 Metro rolls into the shop for a makeover from the inside out; the vehicle's new owner gets a surprise twist.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew works on a rare, American-made classic -- a 1962 Chevy Corvette; the customer wants his muscle car restored to original factory condition, which won't be cheap.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A client loves her trucks, particularly the 1950 Chevy, but with a list of customizations the size of Texas, this build might test Joe's mechanical genius.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Known for its sizzling performance and smooth body style, the 1969 Pontiac GTO is one of the fastest cars of its time; Joe gives it his signature twist with body modifications and a new power train.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Mandi stumbles across a 1971 Volkswagen Karmann Ghia and challenges her husband, Joe, to make the car cool.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe can hardly believe his luck when he finds a pristine '62 Impala owned by a customer who wants to cut it up and strip it back; everything comes to a halt when money troubles threaten to leave this job in limbo.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe gets his hands on a '67 Chevy Nova and the crew has some modifications in store; as all great work comes at a cost, Shag and Amanda need to find a buyer with deep pockets.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A 1959 Chevrolet Impala arrives at the shop looking more like a parts donor than a serious project; unable to turn down a car with such classic style, Joe comes up with a plan.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A client wants Bill to set the bar for custom SUVs with a 2018 Yukon Denali; the guys get busy with chassis, body mods, interior and twin turbos; Ekstensive goes full gangster with a 1948 Mercury, remaking a legendary car from the inside out.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Ekstensive's built a lot of trucks, but never a Ford Bronco until now; Bill and the guys transform a rusted '68 Bronco roadster into a high-powered off-roading truck with a supercharged engine, handmade dash, roll cage, and waterproof interior.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The 2018 Camaro ZL1 is already a high performance sports car, but the owner wants Bill to improve his even more; the guys are happy to oblige, starting with a handmade aluminum chassis and interior; a new client wants his Sierra Denali frame dropped.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the gang are back under the hood of the 2018 Camaro ZL1, rebuilding the engine to add as much power as possible before a visit to the dynamometer; Ekstensive tries to turn a patinated 1949 GMC pickup sleeper truck into a keeper truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team bring a wrecked '70 Suburban hauler back to life as a long bed, four door, crew cab dually with a 5.9 Cummins diesel engine, custom chassis and suspension; a '65 Plymouth Belvedere II gets some extra muscle with a Mopar crate Hemi.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Rusty and riddled with bullet holes, Bill's neighbor hands over the crumbling shell of a '52 Ford F4 Milk Truck; the guys unleash their best fabrication skills and turn this 60-year-old milk truck into a one of a kind, dazzling diesel street rod.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the guys take a good C10 to a hundred with custom touches from inside to out including one of one interior and bed; Ekstensive makes a dream come true by modifying a 2018 Dodge Demon for an under ten-second quarter mile run on the track.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The wrecked shell of a 1970 Suburban car hauler tests Bill and his metal geniuses as they transform it into a high-end diesel, low, long bed, crew cab dually; Ekstensive makes a lifted and loaded F150 for Boots for Troops, a military charity.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill pushes the shop's creativity with his own build of a 2018 Yukon Denali XL; the luxury SUV is their tallest build ever with a custom lift, straight axles and a supercharger; the '70 Suburban gets a custom chassis and body with a fourth door.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the guys are known for their custom metal work, but the transformation of a 1940 International Harvester water truck into a mobile barbecue pit tests all their skills; a 1986 C-10 is a family heirloom that's remade for future generations.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team try to outdo themselves with a radical redesign of 1950 Ford F5 COE, starting with a bed unlike any they've built; the shop begins its first shot at remaking a '69 Corvette Stingray.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The team goes bigger on the yearlong 1950 Ford F5 COE build when the client asks for a last-minute Cummins diesel engine swap; a twisted graphic wraps up a months-long 2001 Ford F350.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team fix another shop's mistakes when a 2017 F-350 is hauled into the shop broken due to a botched lift; a client insists on the ultimate tailgating BBQ trailer with custom everything.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill knows all too well that families are the lifeblood of the custom truck scene; a customer wants to transform a 1965 Ford Falcon Club Wagon into a fully custom family cruiser; a 1966 Cobra replica gets reinforced.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill looks to the year 2073 when the owner of a '73 El Camino challenges the shop to transform his vehicle into the Ride of the Future; the city wants a custom bumper on a 2020 Freightliner tow truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team get their chance to finish a 1968 Chevy C10, which they turn into a unibody by welding the body and bed into one piece; an old dump truck rolls into the shop as the biggest truck the team has ever customized.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A 1937 International Harvester gets a big old Cummins 12-valve diesel engine that's as heavy as the truck itself; a 2005 Chevy Colorado gets a new lease on life as a nitrous-infused drag truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A 1996 dump truck is the largest truck the shop has ever customized; the guys go extra heavy duty to create a military-styled megatruck; a lowrider enthusiast wants a custom air ride and LS swap for his pristine 1934 Buick.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: This year's over-the-top build has Bill and crew lifting a 2020 Chevy Silverado 5500 more than a foot with a custom heavy-duty air suspension; the guys also prove their Texas mettle by radically overhauling the utility bed.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Hall of Fame running back Earl Campbell arrives with the body and parts of a 1949 Cadillac, and the crew is honored to create a ground-up build for the local legend; a 1940 F-100 build snowballs into a much bigger job.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: NFL Hall of Famer Earl Campbell made a career mowing down defenders, so the guys take the same hell-bent approach to rebuilding his 1949 Cadillac; they also customize a van for a disabled motocross rider so he can drive again.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The team revamps an old school '34 Buick into a modern day lowrider; after months of rebuilding the body and making a custom frame for Earl Campbell's '49 Cadillac, the Hall of Famer challenges the shop with a last-minute wrinkle.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Every so often a visionary comes along, and with their imagination, grit and perseverance, they manage to fail and leave a mark on automotive history.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Rob Corddry and Emelia Hartford tell two stories of Japanese visionaries who managed to bring their visions to life and change the car world, despite obstacles.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Rule benders and sneaky geniuses: these are stories of creative risk-takers who know that sometimes you have to break the rules to be the hero.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: There are a million ways to modify a car, but few like these stories. From a manufacturer creating a narrow-use case spec, to one guy making a complete unicorn in his garage, we celebrate some forgotten oddballs of the mod world.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Certain men in the history of cars were just made from different stuff; these two drivers achieved insane feats against impossible odds to prove that they are legends among legends.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Taking a trip back in time to the early days of the automobile, when the first enterprising car enthusiasts laid the foundations for the car world today.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Some cars carry powerful myths with them long after they are gone; these are stories of cars whose intriguing legends have endured long past the metal they are made from.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: The quest for speed has been ingrained in humans since the birth of the wheel; these are stories of people who gathered like-minded speed freaks and created outlaw cultures of pushing the limits of public roads.

programme.title: Super Street Garage

programme.sub-title: Taking a 2016 Subaru BRZ From Fun Commuter to Track-Day Hero

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.sub-title: Beat Down 350Z Drift Missile to Street Shark Dripping With Style
programme.desc: "Hot Rod Garage" built a Nissan 350Z drifter with a welded differential, hydraulic handbrake, steering angle kit and not much else; then they abandoned it; Nads and Amir try to salvage this one with some much-needed style and a Formula Drift debut.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.sub-title: JDM Toyota Chaser Goes From Big-Body Drifter to Quarter-Mile Dragger
programme.desc: The boys score a Japanese-spec, right-hand-drive 1997 Toyota Chaser; it's the perfect recipe for a sideways, big-body drift car, but Nads and Amir want to go in a different direction: straight down the drag strip.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.sub-title: Classing Things Up With a Japanese-Inspired 2005 Lexus LS 430 VIP
programme.desc: VIP cars include rare body kits, oversized wheels and slammed ride heights; the boys try to build something that's true to the roots of the space and make it to an exclusive VIP party reveal.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.sub-title: Giving Our JDM Toyota Chaser a Big Turbo in Pursuit of Big Time Slips
programme.desc: Our quest to transform a drift car into an all-out drag car continues.

programme.title: Super Street Garage
programme.sub-title: Amir's Lotus Elise Is Also Our First EURO Complete With a JDM Twist

programme.title: Custom Carolina

programme.title: Custom Carolina
programme.desc: Tommy and his best friend take a ride back to the '80s; the shop crew transforms a bone-stock 1986 Monte Carlo SS into a LT4 "Monster Carlo" mega machine.

programme.title: Custom Carolina
programme.desc: Tommy's dear friend and father figure Kenny sold his 1960 Chevy Impala when he started a family, and has wanted it back ever since; Tommy finds one and plans to restore it, but keeping the secret is more of a challenge than the team ever imagined.

programme.title: Custom Carolina
programme.desc: Tommy and his team continue the secret '60 Chevy Impala restoration; they revitalize the machine with a new suspension, rebuilt engine and a stunning interior, before reuniting Tommy's father figure with the car of his dreams.

programme.title: Custom Carolina
programme.desc: Tommy Pike and his team restore and modernize a 1955 heirloom Chevy truck.

programme.title: Grande fratello VIP: Live
programme.desc: In diretta dalla casa di Cinecittà, le telecamere seguono gli inquilini protagonisti della nuova edizione de 'Il grande fratello VIP', impegnati nell'accattivarsi le simpatie del pubblico.

programme.title: Fuori dal coro
programme.desc: Striscia settimanale di informazione e attualità condotta dal giornalista Mario Giordano, che si propone di dare voce alle opinioni più controcorrente e particolari.

programme.title: Tira e molla
programme.desc: Show ideato da Corrado Mantoni. Due coppie di concorrenti si sfidano in 4 prove per accumulare il montepremi più alto. Ma nell'ultimo gioco la situazione si può completamente capovolgere.

programme.title: Sport Mediaset
programme.desc: Telegiornale sportivo: novità, anticipazioni, collegamenti in diretta e servizi in esclusiva. Il programma erede di 'Studio Sport' continua a portare nelle case degli italiani le più aggiornate e complete informazioni sul mondo dell'agonismo.

programme.title: Tg4: Diario del giorno
programme.desc: Le principali notizie del momento a cura della redazione della rete. Aggiornamenti e approfondimenti riguardanti politica, cronaca, esteri, economia, sport e attualità.

programme.title: 4 di sera
programme.desc: Uno spazio informativo in cui discutere degli avvenimenti che segnano l'agenda quotidiana, con gli aggiornamenti e le notizie più importanti in materia di cronaca, politica, cultura, società e sport.

programme.title: Forum
programme.desc: Il processo tv che affronta vicende comuni e quotidiane con uno sguardo sempre attento ai temi più attuali. Spazio anche per il confronto dedicato alle cause più complesse, in un dialogo tra generazioni diverse.

programme.title: Lo sportello di Forum
programme.desc: La sessione pomeridiana del tribunale televisivo di Forum: due cittadini affidano la soluzione delle proprie dispute e dei propri contenziosi affidandosi a un giudice e alla legge dello stato.

programme.title: Beautiful
programme.desc: Bill cerca di convincere Liam a non rivelare a nessuno di aver investito e ucciso Vinny. In seguito gli rivela inoltre di aver fatto scomparire tutte le prove che potrebbero incriminarlo.

programme.title: Caduta libera

programme.title: Die Rattenfänger von Hamburg
programme.desc: Das Team der Kammerjäger ist fast rund um die Uhr im Einsatz, oft auch an ungemütlichen Orten.

programme.title: Leben in der Bruchbude
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Misere des sozialen Wohnungsbaus in Form von riesigen, anonymen Mietskasernen. Die Hochhaus-Siedlungen sind zu einem Sammelbecken für Langzeit-Arbeitslose, die auf dem Markt keine bessere Bleibe finden, geworden.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Grizzlybären wählen die besten Lachse während der Laichzeit mithilfe ihres Geruchssinnes aus. Weißkopfseeadler jagen ihre Beute mit scharfem Blick und Krallen. Grauwölfe setzen bei der Jagd auf Teamarbeit und festgelegte Rollen.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Tiere kommunizieren auf vielfältige Weise: Honigbienen nutzen den Schwänzeltanz und Pheromone, Delfine setzen Sonar ein und Präriehunde verfügen über hoch entwickelte Stimmbänder. Blattschneiderameisen erzeugen hingegen Vibrationen.

programme.title: Wildes Mittelmeer
programme.desc: Der Iberische Luchs, einst fast ausgestorben, lebt in einer vielfältigen Landschaft Spaniens. Er teilt sein Reich mit Adlern, Flamingos und einer reichen Tierwelt. Als geschickter Jäger behauptet er seinen Platz als König des Waldes.

programme.title: Wildes Mittelmeer
programme.desc: Der Berberaffe ist heute auf wenige tausend Tiere in Marokkos Wäldern geschrumpft. Seine menschlichen Verhaltensweisen faszinieren. Ähnlich erging es dem Eremitenibis und der Korallenmöwe, die nun langsam in den Mittelmeerraum zurückkehren.

programme.title: Wildes Uganda
programme.desc: Die Reportage gewährt Einblicke in die atemberaubende Naturwelt Ugandas, das im Osten Afrikas liegt. Vielfältige Landschaften bieten Lebensraum für wahre Spezialisten. So etwa Berggorillas oder Elefanten, die in Höhlen nach Salz schürfen.

programme.title: Das Model und die Buschmänner
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation befasst sich mit den Kulturen der Buschmänner im südlichen Afrika. In einigen Dörfern in der Kalahari wird noch heute das Wissen der Älteren über die Natur und die Jagd an die jüngeren Generationen weitervermittelt.

programme.title: Ein schräges Verhältnis - Verrücktes zwischen Mensch und Natur
Tracker Diaries - Die Tiger von Nepal
programme.desc: Casey kommt zusammen mit seinem Kamerateam in Nepal an und trifft sich mit dem lokalen Tigerführer Rajan Chadhary. Rajan ist ein erfahrener Fährtenleser und führt das Team durch den Lebensraum der Tiger im Bardiya-Nationalpark.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Tiger von Nepal
programme.desc: Bei einem Marsch durch den Dschungel stößt Casey mit seinem Team auf einen Tiger. Viele Spuren verlaufen im Nichts, doch auf der Suche begegnen sie zahlreichen anderen Wildtieren und erleben die Vielfalt des Lebensraums hautnah.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Tiger von Nepal
programme.desc: Casey und Rajan diskutieren ihre Taktik bei der Tigersuche: Geduldig am Wasser warten oder aktiv durch den dichten Dschungel pirschen. Am Ende stehen sie den seltenen Großkatzen an einem Flussbett aus nächster Nähe gegenüber.

programme.title: Die Leoparden von Yala
programme.desc: In dem Yala-Nationalpark kommt es in der großen Leoparden-Population zu Rangeleien. Die männlichen Leoparden wollen ihr Territorium beschützen und kämpfen um Paarungsrechte, während die Weibchen das Überleben ihrer Jungen sichern wollen.

programme.title: Lost Places - Vergessene Welten
programme.desc: Um Licht in unbekannte Geschichten aus jener Zeit zu bringen, als Deutschland wichtiger Schauplatz der Frontstellung zwischen Ost und West war, werden verlassene Orte des Kalten Krieges untersucht. Die Spurensuche führt in die Botschaften der USA.

programme.title: Die Erdbeben-Jäger
programme.desc: In Europa kam es in der Vergangenheit bereits zu verheerenden Erdbeben. Zwar ist der alte Kontinent nicht als Hauptrisikogebiet für extreme Beben bekannt, doch die unsichtbare Gefahr aus der Tiefe bleibt für Millionen Menschen eine reale Bedrohung.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Leben mit der Lava auf Island
programme.desc: Seit Monaten reißt im Süden Islands immer wieder die Erde auf und glühende Lavaströme bedrohen die Hafenstadt Grindavík. Die meisten Bewohner haben die Stadt verlassen. Doch einige Grindavíker kehren zurück, sobald die Lava erkaltet ist.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: In Oahu drängen sich 350.000 Einwohner auf engstem Raum. Auf der drittgrößten Insel des Archipels befindet sich der legendäre Waikiki Beach. Vor den Küsten Oahus tummeln sich unzählige Haie im Pazifik. Sie sind enorm wichtig, werden aber gejagt.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: Nirgendwo sonst gibt es eine so große landschaftliche Vielfalt wie auf Hawaii, der am weitesten vom Festland abgelegenen Inselgruppe der Welt. Im Mittelpunkt steht Big Island, die größte und jüngste Insel des Archipels.

programme.title: Kultrevier Davidwache: Polizei auf der Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Trunkenbolde, Feierwütige, geprellte Freier und Touris in Not - sie alle gehören zur Stammkundschaft von Deutschlands kleinstem, aber auch berühmtesten Polizeirevier: der Davidwache. Berichtet wird über den schwierigen Alltag der Polizeibeamten.

programme.title: Kultrevier Davidwache: Polizei auf der Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Die Beamten der Davidwache bewältigen ihren fordernden Dienst auf der Hamburger Reeperbahn. Zwischen nächtlichen Eskalationen und komplexen Ermittlungen zeigt die Dokumentation den harten Alltag im berühmten Amüsierviertel.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Klimaschutz oder Krawall? Der Widerstand der Letzten Generation
programme.desc: Die Klima-Aktivisten der Letzten Generation sorgen seit über einem Jahr für jede Menge Aufmerksamkeit: Maja Winkelmann und Henning Jeschke, von Anfang an dabei, sind überzeugt: Es ist das letzte Mittel, um die Erde vor dem Untergang zu retten.

programme.title: Spiegel TV - Reportage
programme.sub-title: Zwischen Kult und Krawall - unser Kiez Frankfurt!
programme.desc: Das Frankfurter Bahnhofsviertel ist seit Jahren für die Drogenszene und die Gewaltübergriffe bekannt. Der Türsteher Mirko Ferenczy kennt die Gegend gut und beobachtet einen steten Anstieg an Gewalt in der Gegend der Innenstadt.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Zwei Räder liegen im Trend und die Zahl der Menschen, die mit dem Rad unterwegs sind, steigt.

programme.title: Russlands Gewalt-Problem
programme.desc: Im russischen Alltagsleben ist Gewalt genauso allgegenwärtig wie im Machtapparat. Auch unter den Bürgern gilt meist das Recht des Stärkeren. Immer mehr Menschen wollen das allerdings nicht mehr hinnehmen. Sie wünschen sich ein anderes Russland.

programme.title: Russlands Gewalt-Problem

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Das Leiden der Modehunde - Niedlich, aber krankgezüchtet?
programme.desc: Hunderassen wie Mops, Chihuahua oder Bulldogge sind wegen ihres niedlichen Äußeren gefragt. Doch diese Modezüchtungen zahlen oft einen hohen Preis: Sie leiden häufig unter Atemwegs- und Augenerkrankungen, den Zähnen oder der Wirbelsäule.

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: In Hamburg kommt eine merkwürdige Ladung an. Eine Übersee-Lieferung kommt an und die Konstruktion verunsichert die Hafen-Polizei. Dabei soll die Konstruktion einen einzigartigen Lauf der Geschichte über das Meer symbolisieren.

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: In der Pampa Patagoniens wird der Bahnverkehr häufig durch umherziehende Schafe unterbrochen. Grund genug für die Wunderländer, ein witziges Gimmick für die größte Modelleisenbahnanlage der Welt zu bauen. Die Idee: ein Zug soll durch eine Schafherde fahren und diese scheinbar zur Seite treiben. Die technische Umsetzung: eine echte Herausforderung. Knifflig ist auch die Arbeit an der Wellenmaschine, dem neuen Multimedia-Highlight der Anlage.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Nach vier Jahren Bauzeit steht die Eröffnung Patagoniens kurz bevor. Doch der Bahnverkehr läuft alles andere als reibungslos. Die Profis des Wunderlandes arbeiten im Akkord, um die weltgrößte Modelleisenbahn auch im neuen Abschnitt zum Laufen zu bringen. Derweil setzen die Modellbauer die letzten Knopfdruckattraktionen in die Anlage ein. Vom rauchenden Gaucho-Grillfest bis zum beweglichen Wal - Endspurt für die Wunderland-Crew.

programme.title: Lost Places - Vergessene Welten
programme.desc: Um Licht in unbekannte Geschichten aus jener Zeit zu bringen, als Deutschland wichtiger Schauplatz der Frontstellung zwischen Ost und West war, werden verlassene Orte des Kalten Krieges untersucht. Die Spurensuche führt in die Botschaften der USA.

programme.title: Die Erdbeben-Jäger
programme.desc: In Europa kam es in der Vergangenheit bereits zu verheerenden Erdbeben. Zwar ist der alte Kontinent nicht als Hauptrisikogebiet für extreme Beben bekannt, doch die unsichtbare Gefahr aus der Tiefe bleibt für Millionen Menschen eine reale Bedrohung.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Leben mit der Lava auf Island
programme.desc: Seit Monaten reißt im Süden Islands immer wieder die Erde auf und glühende Lavaströme bedrohen die Hafenstadt Grindavík. Die meisten Bewohner haben die Stadt verlassen. Doch einige Grindavíker kehren zurück, sobald die Lava erkaltet ist.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: In Oahu drängen sich 350.000 Einwohner auf engstem Raum. Auf der drittgrößten Insel des Archipels befindet sich der legendäre Waikiki Beach. Vor den Küsten Oahus tummeln sich unzählige Haie im Pazifik. Sie sind enorm wichtig, werden aber gejagt.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: Nirgendwo sonst gibt es eine so große landschaftliche Vielfalt wie auf Hawaii, der am weitesten vom Festland abgelegenen Inselgruppe der Welt. Im Mittelpunkt steht Big Island, die größte und jüngste Insel des Archipels.

programme.title: Nackte Fakten
programme.desc: Die Geschichte der modernen Schönheitschirurgie ist über 100 Jahre alt. Seitdem haben sich die Methoden zur Schaffung eines vermeintlich makellosen Äußeren verfeinert. Längst wird nicht nur geschnitten, gesaugt und genäht.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: In den 1920ern gehen erste Touristen auf Reisen. Nach dem Krieg kommt der Tourismus richtig in Schwung: Im Westen ermöglicht das Wirtschaftswunder den Individualtourismus. Ostdeutschland setzt auf organisierten Staatstourismus.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1891 beginnt die erste organisierte Kreuzfahrt der Geschichte. Dabei ist auch Albert Ballin, der die Hapag zur weltweit größten Reederei ausbaut. Auch in der Bundesrepublik erfreuen sich Kreuzfahrten großer Beliebtheit.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1919 startet das erste maßgeschneiderte Passagierflugzeug der Welt. Nur sieben Jahre später wird in Berlin die "Deutsche Luft Hansa AG" gegründet, die die Nationalsozialisten skrupellos für ihre Zwecke ausnutzen.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Albanien wurde lange mit Kriminalität, Korruption und der Abwanderung der Bevölkerung in Verbindung gebracht. Mittlerweile entwickelt sich das Land an der Adria nicht nur zur interessanten Urlaubsdestination, sondern auch zu einem Auswanderer-Ziel.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Auswanderer in Grönland - Lust auf Eis und Einsamkeit
programme.desc: Wer in Grönland leben möchte, muss das arktische Klima und die Einsamkeit mögen. Die größte Insel der Welt ist zugleich eine der am dünnsten besiedelten Regionen. Doch der arktische Norden ist für viele Auswanderer ein Sehnsuchtsziel.

programme.title: Mit dem Rucksack durch Nepal
programme.desc: Die Brüder Dennis und Patrick Weinert begeben sich auf eine dreimonatige Reise durch Nepal. Neben Abenteuern im Dschungel und auf Bergen treffen die Brüder auch auf Einheimische und reden mit ihnen über die Beziehung von Mensch und Natur.

programme.title: Buddhas Kämpfer
programme.desc: In einem Wald bei Kaiserslautern liegt das einzige Shaolin-Kloster Europas, das Kampfmönche ausbildet. Novizen und Meister trainieren hier bis zu acht Stunden täglich. Ziel sind körperliche Grenzerfahrungen und die Befreiung des Geistes.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: In den 1920ern gehen erste Touristen auf Reisen. Nach dem Krieg kommt der Tourismus richtig in Schwung: Im Westen ermöglicht das Wirtschaftswunder den Individualtourismus. Ostdeutschland setzt auf organisierten Staatstourismus.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1891 beginnt die erste organisierte Kreuzfahrt der Geschichte. Dabei ist auch Albert Ballin, der die Hapag zur weltweit größten Reederei ausbaut. Auch in der Bundesrepublik erfreuen sich Kreuzfahrten großer Beliebtheit.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1919 startet das erste maßgeschneiderte Passagierflugzeug der Welt. Nur sieben Jahre später wird in Berlin die "Deutsche Luft Hansa AG" gegründet, die die Nationalsozialisten skrupellos für ihre Zwecke ausnutzen.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Albanien wurde lange mit Kriminalität, Korruption und der Abwanderung der Bevölkerung in Verbindung gebracht. Mittlerweile entwickelt sich das Land an der Adria nicht nur zur interessanten Urlaubsdestination, sondern auch zu einem Auswanderer-Ziel.

programme.title: Blut und Spiele für die Polizei: Fußball-EM in Deutschland
programme.desc: Vier Wochen hat Deutschland Fußball geschaut. Währenddessen hat die Berliner Polizei ohne Ende Überstunden gemacht. Denn Millionen Fans aus aller Herren Ländern im Griff zu haben, ist wie ein Sack euphorisierte und betrunkene Flöhe zu hüten.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail
programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. programme.title: Colorado Serenade
programme.desc: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. programme.title: Niagara Niagara
programme.desc: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Ambush Trail
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: Yankee Fakir
programme.desc: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing.

When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Bikini Machine
programme.desc: The dastardly Dr. Goldfoot (Vincent Price) and his sidekick, Igor (Jack Mullaney), build a race of bikini-wearing beauties who are designed to win the hearts and fortunes of the most influential men of the world. Before long, the manufactured women begin to succeed, and Robot 11 (Susan Hart) is sent to coax multimillionaire Todd Armstrong (Dwayne Hickman) into handing over his wealth. Government spy Craig Gamble (Frankie Avalon) tracks down Robot 11, but even he isn't immune to her charms.

programme.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Girl Bombs
programme.desc: The scheming Dr. Goldfoot (Vincent Price) is determined to conquer the world yet again, this time by deploying a legion of explosive robots that happen to look like gorgeous women. Fortunately for the citizens of the globe, suave secret agent Bill Dexter (Fabian) is out to foil Goldfoot's plans, which involve kidnapping a prominent American general (also Price) who bears a striking resemblance to Goldfoot. Also getting in on the antics is inept aspiring spy Franco (Franco Franchi).

programme.title: The Charge of the Light Brigade
programme.desc: During the Crimean War between Britain and Russia in the 1850s, a British cavalry division, led by the overbearing Lord Cardigan (Trevor Howard), engages in an infamously reckless strategic debacle against a Russian artillery battery. An inept chain of command and the arrogance of the aristocratic officers nearly destroys the brigade. Interpersonal wars within the unit, including unfaithful wives and a rivalry between Lord Cardigan and Captain Nolan (David Hemmings), heighten the conflict.

programme.title: Hannibal Brooks
programme.desc: A British prisoner of war is assigned to take care of an elephant in a zoo. Along with an American and an Austrian he escapes with the elephant and heads for the Swiss border. They use the elephant to gain access across the border. A Polish girl betrays them and aligns herself with the Nazis.

programme.title: The Russians Are Coming, the Russians Are Coming
programme.desc: When a Soviet submarine gets stuck on a sandbar off the coast of a New England island, its commander (Theodore Bikel) orders his second-in-command, Lieutenant Rozanov (Alan Arkin), to get them moving again before there is an international incident. Rozanov seeks assistance from the island locals, including the police chief (Brian Keith) and a vacationing television writer (Carl Reiner), while trying to allay their fears of a Communist invasion by claiming he and his crew are Norwegian sailors.

programme.title: War, Italian Style
programme.desc: Two Marines (Fred Clark) fool a German general (Buster Keaton) with documents and disguises in World War II Italy.

programme.title: The Square Peg
programme.desc: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: The Missing Lady
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) links an art dealer's corpse to a stolen jade figurine.

programme.title: Confidence Girl
programme.desc: A young woman's inherent honesty leads to the downfall of her conniving boyfriend's scams.

programme.title: The Girl in Black Stockings
programme.desc: Residents at a posh Utah hotel become suspects when a girl is found murdered during a pool party. Local sheriff Jess Holmes (John Dehner) takes charge of the investigation and must discover who among the terrified guests and staff -- including bodacious vixen Harriet Ames (Mamie Van Doren), the hotel's bitter, crippled proprietor (Ron Randell), visiting lawyer David Hewson (Lex Barker) and his secretary, Beth (Anne Bancroft) -- is the culprit, even as murders continue to take place.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo (Frank Silvera), who has eyes for his employee. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: A Kiss Before Dying
programme.desc: Amoral Bud Corliss (Robert Wagner) pursues young heiress Dorie Kingship (Joanne Woodward) in the hopes of getting his hands on the fortune amassed by her father (George Macready). But after Dorie succumbs to Bud's charms and becomes pregnant as a result, he fears she'll be cut off by the family and murders her in a fashion that makes it look as if the poor girl committed suicide. When Bud tries to cozy up with Dorie's grieving sister, Ellen (Virginia Leith), she begins to suspect his intentions.

programme.title: The Captive City
programme.desc: A private investigator informs small-town newspaper editor Jim Austin of corrupt local activity. When the investigator is killed, Austin believes it's an act of revenge, and his own detective work reveals a network of gambling and corruption. Crime boss Murray Sirak controls the whole town, including the police. Sirak answers to his own boss, "Mr. Big," who is seemingly untouchable, but Austin risks his life to expose the truth.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: The Devil's 8
programme.desc: A federal agent (Christopher George) trains escaped chain-gang convicts for a mission to bust a Southern moonshine racket.

programme.title: Operation Kid Brother
programme.desc: Sean's brother plays a hypnotic plastic surgeon (Neil Connery), pressed into service as a James Bond-type spy.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Brain
programme.desc: Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is a former British secret agent who has taken up work as a private detective. An anonymous party hires him to deliver a seemingly normal package to Helsinki. However, he learns that he has been deceived into working for the Secret Service again, and is actually returning stolen virus-infected eggs to a government lab. Palmer is then persuaded to thwart a manic Texas oil baron (Ed Begley) who is planning to attack the Soviet Union with a supercomputer.

programme.title: Triple Deception
programme.desc: Police in Paris recruit an English ship's officer (Michael Craig) to help trap counterfeiters by joining them.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: Foreign Intrigue
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his millionaire boss, Dave Bishop (Robert Mitchum) begins a quest to discover the source of his mysterious employer's wealth. On a journey that will take Bishop across the European continent, life-threatening encounters lurk around every corner. As Bishop soon finds out, his boss acquired his wealth through underhanded schemes and blackmail. Now that their blackmailer is dead, those who are free want to keep Bishop from taking his place.

programme.title: Pier 5, Havana
programme.desc: Miami businessman Steve Daggett (Cameron Mitchell) arrives in Havana in the wake of the revolution, looking for his army buddy Hank (Logan Field), a hard-drinking mechanic who has suddenly vanished. Steve follows a trail that leads him to the apartment of his old flame -- Hank's current wife, Monica (Allison Hayes) -- and to a boat shop where he is beaten up by strangers and warned to leave Cuba. He discovers that Hank's disappearance is linked to a conspiracy to depose Fidel Castro.

programme.title: Attack!
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Costa (Jack Palance) is a part of Fragile Fox Company, a National Guard unit sent to a Belgian town in the final stages of World War II. Costa harbors some serious doubts about the leadership abilities of Captain Cooney (Eddie Albert), a coward who only secured his position because of his ties to Lt. Col. Bartlett (Lee Marvin). Cooney's inexperience and his open contempt for Costa threaten the lives of his men as they draw closer to Battle of the Bulge.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: The son of Philip of Macedonia (Fredric March) and Olympias (Danielle Darrieux), Alexander the Great (Richard Burton) is one of the most legendary leaders throughout history. As the Macedonian king, Alexander successfully unites all the ancient Greek tribes and leads them to defeat the imposing Persian Empire. With the fall of Babylon, Alexander continues to conquer most of the known world. Eventually, he achieves the status of unparalleled ruler atop his newly formed Greek empire.

programme.title: Witness to Murder
programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

After finding $10,000 on the street, Henry takes the money home, but quickly finds out that the cash came from his workplace. Soon Henry is on the run with his kids, while their baby sitter, Golda (Phyllis Diller), tries to throw her none-too-bright police officer boyfriend, Jasper Lynch (Jonathan Winters), off their trail. programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: A Woman Possessed
programme.desc: A man feels torn between allegiances to his mother and to his fiancée.

programme.title: By Love Possessed
programme.desc: After his wife, Clarissa (Barbara Bel Geddes), accuses him of being incapable of love, prominent Massachusetts lawyer Arthur Winner (Efrem Zimbalist Jr.) begins a torrid affair with the alcoholic spouse (Lana Turner) of his sexually disabled business partner Julius Penrose (Jason Robards Jr.). Arthur also struggles in his attempts to persuade his wayward son Warren (George Hamilton) to become a lawyer like him -- even though his own career brought him neither fulfillment nor emotional stability.

programme.title: Lost Lagoon
programme.desc: Charlie Walker (Jeffrey Lynn), a middle-aged businessman, grows weary of his middle-class life and his family. The stress gets so bad that Walker flees his responsibilities and takes to the open sea in his boat. A storm destroys the vessel, and he winds up stranded on a Caribbean island. Once there, he mixes with the locals and falls in love with a younger woman, Elizabeth Moore (Leila Barry). But Walker starts to feel the strain of his new life and wonders if he made the right decision.

programme.title: Two for the Seesaw
programme.desc: After leaving his wife, lawyer Jerry Ryan (Robert Mitchum) moves from Omaha, Neb., to New York City to start a new life. While studying for the New York Bar Examination and working to finalize his divorce, Ryan meets dancer Gittel Mosca (Shirley MacLaine), and the two begin a cautious courtship. However, Ryan feels that he must come to terms with his failed marriage and overcome his lingering attachment to his ex-wife before he can redefine himself and embrace his budding romance.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. programme.title: Diggstown
programme.desc: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on.

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.desc: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist.
