programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children.

programme.title: The Limbic Region
programme.desc: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession.

programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Scream Blacula Scream
programme.desc: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge.

programme.title: Rebel in Town
programme.desc: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.title: Halliday Brand
programme.desc: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution.

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge
programme.desc: Under the eye of timid Capt. George (Lloyd Bridges), a group of Cheyenne Native Americans are on a forced march from their homelands to a reservation. When builders strike gold on their new settlement, the Cheyenne are diverted to make way for greedy prospectors. Tate (Rory Calhoun), who is secretly in love with Pretty Willow, is sent to scout a new location for the Cheyenne. Tensions quickly arise between the cavalry and the vengeful Chief Little Wolf (Vince Edwards).

programme.title: More Dead Than Alive
programme.desc: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him.

programme.title: Robbery Under Arms

programme.title: Toughest Gun in Tombstone

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge
programme.desc: Under the eye of timid Capt. George (Lloyd Bridges), a group of Cheyenne Native Americans are on a forced march from their homelands to a reservation. When builders strike gold on their new settlement, the Cheyenne are diverted to make way for greedy prospectors. Tate (Rory Calhoun), who is secretly in love with Pretty Willow, is sent to scout a new location for the Cheyenne. Tensions quickly arise between the cavalry and the vengeful Chief Little Wolf (Vince Edwards).

programme.title: More Dead Than Alive
programme.desc: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him.

programme.title: Vivah: A Journey From Engagement to Marriage
programme.desc: Harishchandra (Anupam Kher) is a widower raising his sons, Sunil (Samir Soni) and Prem (Shahid Kapoor). As they grow up, Sunil gets married, while the younger Prem continues his studies before being matched with Poonam (Amrita Rao), who lost her parents at a young age. Following some awkward initial interactions, the young couple begin having feelings for each other, and a wedding is planned. However, after Prem returns from a business trip in Japan, a tragic accident puts everything in doubt.

programme.desc: Multitalented entertainers David and Tamela Mann are known mostly for their stage and screen collaborations with producer Tyler Perry ("Meet the Browns"). "It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years.

The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day.

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly "1 Big Thing" commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in "Bad Beats." The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

programme.title: 2026 Madera Racing
programme.desc: For 5 decades Madera Speedway has been a staple in the West Coast short track scene and each week we showcase up-and-coming stock car drivers who are looking to take the next step in their career.

programme.title: Road to Glory
programme.desc: We go behind the scenes and get to know the drivers behind the helmet; from seasoned veterans to young upstarts, each racer has a different path but one goal -- to win the title.

programme.title: Transform your home today, fast & easy!
programme.desc: RotoRazer is the world's greatest jigsaw, circular saw, band saw, tile saw and hacksaw all-in-one amazing easy to use tool!

programme.title: Men's Health - All-Natural Secret for Prostate Health
programme.desc: Prosvent is a doctor-formulated blend of rejuvenating herbs and nutrients that help protect overall prostate health.

programme.title: 2026 Best of GAA Classic Car Auctions
programme.desc: Highlights the top moments, the rarest finds and biggest sales from the GAA Classic Cars Auction.

programme.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
programme.desc: A severely deteriorated 1960 Porsche 356B becomes the foundation for an interpretation of an automotive icon; Pete Jackson and his team reshape the car with flowing body contours, balanced design details and a thoughtfully upgraded engine; see how ingenuity, symmetry and in-house craftsmanship preserve the Porsche's character while creating the sport compact/import performance category winner at the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders.

programme.title: Northern Tool Legends With Kyle Petty
programme.desc: A group of high school shop class students takes on a custom motorcycle project with guidance from industry legends. As the build comes together, the team learns the skills and techniques needed to turn a vision into reality.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: A Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop; a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions.

programme.title: My Classic Car
programme.desc: Host Dennis Gage upholds his "honor the timeless classics" catchphrase in this series, as he travels across North America to visit prestigious auto shows and events, spotlighting everything from muscle cars to museum pieces. The handlebar mustachioed Gage takes viewers along for the ride and keeps it entertaining with his unique perspective and enthusiasm for all things automotive.

programme.title: The Charge: Mustangs at Le Mans
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the Mustang Challenge held an international round at the famed Circuit de la Sarthe, as nearly 40 Mustangs took to the iconic track and competed in the race of a lifetime. We meet the drivers, including Tanner Faust and Frankie Muniz, and chronicle all the on track action... in The Charge: Mustangs at Le Mans.

programme.title: Lucky No. 7
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes of one of off-road racing's biggest, roughest, and most iconic events: the Mint 400 in Las Vegas.

programme.title: 2026 Lamborghini Super Trofeo
programme.desc: Lamborghini Super Trofeo North America heads west to Monterey and WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca's Corkscrew, where last year a thrilling photo finish occurred.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
programme.desc: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

programme.title: Birth of the Blues
programme.desc: Jeff Lambert (Bing Crosby), who has grown up in New Orleans surrounded by black music, determines to start a band featuring white cornet player Memphis (Brian Donlevy). However, the Basin Street Hotshots are rejected from several venues for playing "black" jazz, until singer Betty Lou Cobb (Mary Martin) insists they be hired as her backup band. The band finds success until Jeff and Memphis fall out over Betty Lou, then get entangled with gangster Blackie (J. Carrol Naish).

programme.title: Girl Crazy
programme.desc: Distracted by female students and performing poorly in the classroom, Danny Churchill Jr. (Mickey Rooney) moves west to a university that his father believes is free of temptation. Soon, though, Danny strikes up a friendship with Ginger Gray (Judy Garland). When Ginger, whose family runs the all-male college, explains that the school has money troubles, creative Danny puts together a big fundraiser. The event highlights their song-and-dance skills and also cements their bond.

programme.title: Strike Up the Band
programme.desc: Teenage drummer Jimmy Connors dreams of winning the contest for school bands hosted by popular band leader Paul Whiteman (himself). In order to enter, Jimmy and his pals, including charming vocalist Mary Holden, must accumulate $200 for the train ride to Chicago, where the contest will be held. Jimmy and his friends decide to put on an epic student play to raise the funds they need, but a sudden illness threatens to cost the band their chance.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band that constantly practices. Soon, Jimmy finds himself trying to help the band by getting them gigs and trying to reconcile the family with his uncle, an avid music-hater.

programme.title: God Is My Co-Pilot
programme.desc: Col. Robert L. Scott is an adept fighter pilot who unfortunately finds himself too old to fly fighter planes in World War II. Assigned to India, he later meets Maj. Gen. Claire L. Chennault, who commands the famous "Flying Tigers" squadron in China. Chennault finally allows Scott to learn combat flying techniques on an obsolete training plane. Scott is so good that Chennault gives him his wish -- he will fly combat missions with the Tigers.

programme.title: My Wild Irish Rose
programme.desc: In this musical, Chauncey Olcott (Dennis Morgan) -- a character based on the real-life 19th-century singer-songwriter -- starts off as a minstrel show performer, but his life and career completely change when singer Lillian Russell (Andrea King) gives him a starring role in a Broadway show. Olcott's girlfriend, Rose (Arlene Dahl), gets jealous, suspecting an affair. But in spite of his relationship battles, Olcott's star rises with a series of ballads, including the title track.

programme.title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
programme.desc: While waiting for his Balkan country to vote on whether to abolish its monarchy, Prince Henry (Dennis Morgan) comes to New York City to observe ordinary life. Slipping away in disguise from his welcome party, the prince becomes friends with cab driver Buzz Williams (Jack Carson). After Buzz discovers the prince's identity, he lets his girlfriend, Connie (Joan Leslie), show the royal around the city. As the public wonders where the prince has disappeared to, he and Connie fall in love.

programme.title: The Desert Song
programme.desc: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang

programme.title: Key Largo
programme.desc: This classic film noir by John Huston stars Humphrey Bogart as World War II vet Frank McCloud. But McCloud realizes that mobsters, led by the infamous Johnny Rocco, are staying in the hotel. When the criminals take over the establishment, conflict is inevitable.

programme.title: The Subject Was Roses
programme.desc: Timmy Cleary (Martin Sheen), who was once considered timid, returns from duty in World War II with newfound confidence. John is a heavy drinker guilty of numerous infidelities, while Nettie has deeply resented her husband and coddled Timmy for years. programme.title: Some Came Running

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Despite being welcomed home as a hero, youthful Marine Cliff Harper (Guy Madison) tries to forget the horrific violence of World War II as he faces uncertainty, unemployment and post-traumatic stress. While transitioning back to civilian life, Cliff falls for Pat Ruscomb (Dorothy McGuire), a grieving widow haunted by the loss of her pilot husband. Cliff struggles to convince Pat to join him in a mutual new beginning, but first she must overcome her longing for her life before the war.

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Naval Captain Torrey (John Wayne) manages to bring his ship through the bombing of Pearl Harbor unscathed, but is later demoted when it is damaged in a subsequent battle due to his negligence. programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Longfellow Deeds is a sweet, lovable guy leading a simple but happy life in the tiny hamlet of Mandrake Falls, New Hampshire. Life is good at the small town restaurant until two corporate execs bring news that Deeds is about to be rolling in a different kind of dough. A long-lost relative has left him an inheritance of 40 billion dollars along with the largest media company in the world. It's a fish out of water, rags-to-riches story that has local tabloid reporters salivating.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: Cuando me sonreís
programme.desc: Una comedia romántica que cuenta cómo la vida de Gastón Murfi un exitoso promotor musical, soltero codiciado, apuesto, metódico, ordenado y con una fobia a relaciones duraderas cambia con la aparición de su padre Juan a quien dejó de ver cuando era un adolescente, la llegada de un hijo que desconocía su existencia y ante el amor que se le presentará ante sus ojos pero que el mismo se encargará de negarlo, con la llegada al barrio de una nueva vecina llamada Luna quien instala un bar junto a su hermana Mili.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: ReMexa
programme.desc: Un espacio para los fanáticos de la música regional mexicana, el género musical latino más popular en los Estados Unidos. Entrevistas, acceso exclusivo detrás de bambalinas, conciertos y las últimas noticias de los artistas regionales más importantes del momento. programme.title: Ancestras
programme.desc: Acompaña a Margarita de la Vega Lázaro, quien ha enseñado durante años el manejo del telar de cintura y la lengua otomí de Temoaya, Estado de México. programme.desc: Programa dedicado a las conferencias que Noel Díaz ha impartido en diferentes eventos durante los últimos 36 años en Los Ángeles, California, así como en misiones en Estados Unidos y Latinoamérica, como parte de su apostolado de evangelización.

programme.title: Santa María y los santos

programme.desc: Conjunto de oraciones que muestran devoción a la Divina Misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.desc: Las últimas noticias, momentos destacados e información de todos los rincones del mundo del deporte se presenta cada día en "SportsCenter", el primer programa de ESPN cuando la red se estrenó en septiembre de 1979. programme.title: 奪魂鈴 / The Bells of Death
programme.desc: 故事描述，少年衛虎家遭左景龍、應天與楊剛所洗劫，父母幼弟被殺，姊衛芸被左劫走，頓時家破人亡。虎憤恨萬狀，放火燒毀家園，決心遠走天涯，找尋仇人報復；虎流浪各地，遇隱名大俠士，投拜為師，數年即習藝有成，遂往找仇人；虎抵雞兒鎮，遇弱女香香遭逼為娼，逐出手相助，擊退歹徒...

programme.title: 邪鬥邪 / Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: 餘腩沉溺賭海，由於欠債累累無力償還，遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破，並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭，可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯，老伯答應給餘巨額現金，只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸...

programme.title: 飛燕金刀 / Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天，並設計先偷飛龍刀，再殺害李志山及女兒小燕，幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫。小燕長大後，更成為武功高強的女劍客，誓要為死去的母親報仇。直至一個偶然的機會，小燕遇到仍然在生的母親，才駭然發現真相，原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙。.

programme.title: 春火 / My Son
programme.desc: 楊國良是探長兒子，國良怪父沉迷工作，母離世仍在查案，隔膜頓生。國良遇上舞女梅琳，兩人母親皆歿，了解下迅即同居生活。國良因生活費花盡到俱樂部賭錢，被陳彪騙下巨款，更強姦梅琳。國良憤然殺死陳彪，遭警察圍捕......

programme.title: 笑傲江湖 / The Proud Youth
programme.desc: 華山派大弟子令狐沖要找出一個繼承「笑傲江湖」琴譜的人。當令狐沖發現任盈盈為合適人選時，卻發現她竟是魔教教主任我行之女，同時他亦一步步捲入正邪兩道的權鬥陰謀和道義兩難的困境。.

programme.title: 獵人 / Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事，周丟棄劉明華，又去追獵呂綺美，劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚，呂遭殺死，警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人，一個一個的被殺死，嫌兇漸指向他，好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。.

programme.title: 少林傳人 / Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位，率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮；皇帝見大勢已去，命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下，大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養，法號道行，習得少林絕技；二太子則易名五子泰，由丞相撫養。多年後，五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」，與道行相遇，卻不知對方正是親兄弟…….

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳續集 / The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝，並娶得黃蓉為妻，於是把黃蓉挾走，要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範？.

programme.title: 保鏢 / Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力，於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中，他們遇到了一名神秘俠客，三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪，竭力保護黃金不被劫走。.

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神 / Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: 軍閥割據時代，江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮，「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣，反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳 / The Brave Archer
programme.desc: 郭靖回到中原時，遇上黃蓉，二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料，同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿，對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰，郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克，奪得美人歸。.

programme.title: 蝴蝶盃 / The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: 明朝時代，書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義，誤殺總督之子，被迫逃亡。走投無路時，他逃至江畔，幸得漁夫之女相救。二人在險境中情愫暗生，玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物，締結終身之約。.

programme.title: 群英會 / Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: 本片由三個單元故事組成，為岳楓、程剛及張徹聯合執導，當年就有「花一張票價，看三套電影」的稱譽。嶽楓之〈鐵弓緣〉講述一對青年男女因一把鐵弓而結緣、程剛之〈胭脂虎〉講述一群絕色妓女的故事、張徹之〈白水灘〉講述梁山英雄後代的故事。.

programme.title: 鬼新娘 / The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏，兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂，但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下，方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻，然而人鬼殊途，兩人於晨光中淒然訣別，冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。.

programme.title: 鬼新娘 / The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏，兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂，但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下，方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻，然而人鬼殊途，兩人於晨光中淒然訣別，冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。.

programme.title: 插翅難飛 / The Convict Killer
programme.desc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手，遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者，高明說出乃黑豹所為後，即被開槍殺死，鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年。他出獄後即找黑豹報仇，卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾；同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫，欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落，但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名，從未見其人，究竟黑豹是誰？.

programme.title: 慾燄狂流 / Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆，同時愛上胡燕妮，但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱，故當胡懷孕時，就懷疑妻與楊有染….

programme.title: 來如風 / The Swift Knight
programme.desc: 明皇身染惡疾，駕崩在即，卻無子可繼帝位；皇侄世子傑本可繼位，惜不成器，難當大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一，現時藏匿于東陽縣，遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落。劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺，幸得俠士來如風相助...

programme.title: 楊乃武與小白菜 / The Adulteress
programme.desc: 劇情講述，知縣之子劉子和，垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜，用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發，用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後，鎮內流言四起，知縣為救愛兒，設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招，其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死，到刑部要求翻案…….

programme.title: 十三太保 / The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: 故事講述于唐朝年間，沙陀國主有十三義子，皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英，因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間，最後更演變成兄弟相殘。.

programme.title: 鏢旗飛揚 / The Protectors
programme.desc: 淩霄及關望龍同為一流鏢師，深得主人器重。關單戀主人孫女方燕，方卻情系于淩。關遷怒淩，竟與黑道中人金不換密谋劫鏢，嫁禍淩...

programme.title: 青春戀 / Young Lovers
programme.desc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司，其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端，圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈，化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困，自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。.

programme.title: 劍女幽魂 / Mission Impossible
programme.desc: 劍聖女兒霍小芬受命將早前被盜的鎮國之寶金龍寶劍送回京師，途中卻遭玉面童子爪牙截擊和毒害身亡。小芬為報此仇，藉寶劍靈氣還魂，竭盡全力把金龍寶劍送返京師，更成功將玉面童子消滅。最後她把劍親手送交皇上，升天而去。.

programme.title: 包剪石沓 / Melody of Love
programme.desc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇，三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可，被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象，他們的追女橋段層出不窮，用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方，卻全部失靈，烏龍百出...

programme.title: 唐人街功夫小子 / Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父，因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害，迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作，後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪，二人展開連場惡戰。.

programme.title: 山歌戀 / The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: 牧羊女古秀秀喜唱山歌，父親嗜賭如命；青年劉大龍與秀對唱山歌，情愫互生。曾老虎以追債要脅古老頭許婚；劉欲酬錢替秀父還債。怎知帆船歸來而劉卻失蹤！秀無奈答允出嫁...

programme.title: 皇家大賊 / Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: 幹探周福祥的好友阿金因誤殺途人而辭職，淪為職業殺手。金所執行的多宗兇殺案中，恰巧由周負責，好友二人面臨生死決鬥...

programme.title: 三十年細說從頭 / Passing Flickers
programme.desc: 大導演李翰祥改編自己大受歡迎的專欄，盡現電影圈光怪陸離的趣事及傳聞，由愛將劉永和戴良純扮演不同角色，保證令你捧腹大笑。.

programme.title: 廣東十虎與後五虎 / Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰，在賭館當巡場；一夜，十虎的徒弟及後人等四人，在賭場相聚時，旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲，把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等，昔日曾把父殺死，以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手，殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人，為父報仇...

programme.title: 廣東十虎與後五虎 / Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰，在賭館當巡場；一夜，十虎的徒弟及後人等四人，在賭場相聚時，旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲，把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等，昔日曾把父殺死，以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手，殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人，為父報仇...

programme.title: 艷陽天 / Blue Skies
programme.desc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛，常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人，得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出，心卻惦念燕南，一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執，怎料汽車失事...

programme.title: 單程路 / One Way Only
programme.desc: 李修賢是一摩托車行東主，曾是著名車手，惟一次意外中傷殘；他對學徒麥德羅甚為賞識，麥因李之啟蒙而在澳門賽車中奪標。李聞悉麥參與非法賽車，予以規勸，惟麥受盛名之累，欲罷不能….

programme.title: 裸血 / Raw Passions
programme.desc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠，均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染，孟藉此勒索二人；後孟被殺，高成嫌疑犯，另孟之兄翟諾，亦向高勒索；而淩在家，也接見了穀峰，他聲言有為高洗罪的證據，但要索錢；王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶？.

programme.title: 兒女是我們的 / The Younger Generation
programme.desc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文，為了自由戀愛，脫離父母，從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女，但生存的擔子日重，二人長期辛勞，終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭，直接面對複雜的社會，幾乎各散東西…….

programme.title: 十四女英豪 / The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: 赤膽忠心的楊家將，世世代代為國而戰，子子孫孫為民而死，直戰到最後一員虎將楊宗保，不幸在金山之役中了埋伏，全營將士壯烈犧牲。楊宗保身負箭傷，被困金山，以身殉國。楊家滿門為保衛宋朝江山及替楊宗保報仇，在老祖母佘老太君的發起下，組成了一支楊家軍，誓與番邦周旋到底!

programme.title: 教頭 / The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害，成殺人疑犯，惟匿藏孟家任教頭。後王收好武青年周平為徒，卻惹孟不滿；原來周、孟兩大族為死敵，孟覺聘王當教頭，實乃養虎為患，遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲，幸王逃過大難，只是受了傷。孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為，且對王很有好感，遂暗中援手...

programme.title: 至尊一劍 / The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新劍術高超，連敗九十九名劍手，終在最後一擊敗在劍神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄寶劍，遂殺死著名鑄劍師老鷹，奪取稀世的「老鷹寶劍」。老鷹之子燕北悲痛萬分，矢誓報仇，不自量力挑戰五新，結果被打落懸崖之下...

programme.title: 金石情 / Forever And Ever
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋，其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿，意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出，孝文感於貞蓮真情，決意回鄉稟明母親，迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後，貞蓮萬念俱灰，竟狂飲毒酒，以圖自盡...

programme.title: 成記茶樓 / The Tea House
programme.desc: 大哥成從大陸逃到香港，在屋邨經營茶樓，本想安分守己，卻屢遭惡勢力挑釁，而警方卻袖手旁觀，迫使大哥成和茶樓的朋友們決定以牙還牙！.

programme.title: 插翅虎 / The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭，插翅虎及活閻王，的武功，他們必定獨霸武林，江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟，決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞？誰可挽救一場武林浩劫？.

programme.title: 少林五祖 / Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷，處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟，於是火燒少林寺。事出突然，寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生還弟子，決意為死去的少林弟子報仇。五人潛心修煉終成正果，被後世稱為“少林五祖”。.

programme.title: 舞衣 / Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅，與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住，三女各有愛情際遇；白眉雖愛錢，卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊，兩人只好互許後會有期之願；朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師，分手後又愛上賽車手；姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫，她本最愛窮工人李吉，李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手，姚姚嫁予富家子，卻仍掛念李吉...

programme.title: 十二金牌 / The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: 奸相秦檜偽造十二道金牌，密謀強召抗金前線的岳飛退兵。華山俠士苗龍為救國運，率江湖義士沿途設卡攔截金牌。不料護送金牌的爪牙首領竟是其恩師金彥堂，令苗龍陷入忠義兩難。最終師徒在客棧反目血戰，苗龍雖拚死奪下金牌，卻仍難挽回歷史的千古遺憾。.

programme.title: 蛇王子 / The Snake Prince
programme.desc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將；一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞，蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災，蛇王子答應率蛇作法，引水入寨，但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...

programme.title: 蛇王子 / The Snake Prince
programme.desc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將；一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞，蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災，蛇王子答應率蛇作法，引水入寨，但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...

programme.title: 蕩寇誌 / All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續。七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家，奉命征討宦官專權。展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰。.

programme.title: 多咀街 / Gossip Street
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道，住客大多是各行各業的小市民。他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論，七嘴八舌，招惹是非；三言兩語，道出人情冷暖，有道是：言為心聲。不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機，他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好，都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑。.

programme.title: 玫瑰我愛你 / Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發，兩人被迫分手。七年後，玫瑰得知家聰結婚，傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後，丈夫去世，開了一間花店，一天，小女孩來買花，才知小女孩是自己女兒，更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇，保持作深情，感人之水準。.

programme.title: 魂斷奈何天 / Dawn will Come
programme.desc: 良才見秋容貌美，心懷不軌，竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑，相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後，良才音訊全無，秋容更發現自已懷有身孕，於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻，更打算將秋容滅口….

programme.title: 魚美人 / The Mermaid
programme.desc: 貧寒書生張珍投奔相府，卻遭嫌貧愛富的準岳父冷落。碧波潭鯉魚精同情他的遭遇，化身相國千金，深夜與張珍相會，兩人漸生情愫。此事引發「真假千金」鬧相府的風波，更招來張天師降妖圍剿。面對天兵天將，張珍誓死不離，最終感動觀音，令鯉魚精化為凡人，與張珍終成眷屬。.

programme.title: 玉面飛狐 / The Silver Fox
programme.desc: 夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局掌門義子。司馬秋利慾薰心，設計弒殺師父，更以暗鏢毀去夏梧面容。重傷的夏梧懷抱年幼長女逃走，懷孕妻子卻於昏迷中遭司馬秋姦污。夏梧隱居深山，將仇恨寄託長女青青，苦心培育其成為武藝高強的「玉面飛狐」，命她下山劫鏢尋仇。.

programme.title: 鍾馗娘子 / The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: 鍾馗娘子被邪惡的黑金剛擊敗後，隱居多年，處心積慮要復仇。女俠翠屏勇猛堅毅，為剷除黑金剛，懇求鍾馗娘子收她為徒。娘子與翠屏兩師徒聯手對付黑金剛，也是他大限將至的時侯。.

programme.title: 洪拳與詠春 / Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺，殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子，分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下，學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人，並為死去師兄弟報仇。.

programme.title: 野姑娘 / Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女，面對惡霸從不退縮，總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後，立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好，她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運，改寫結局？.

programme.title: 西遊記 / The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經，中途在五指山收服馬騮精；在高家莊收服豬八戒；在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。.

programme.title: 我為你狂 / Pale Passion
programme.desc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久，但發有神經錯亂，霞為除心理負擔，忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心，令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業，令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間，發狂性大發，霞流產，再次離開發...

programme.title: 影子神鞭 / The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: 三十萬鏢銀被持神鞭作武器的劫鏢者劫去。因神鞭是有「影子神鞭」之稱的武林大師方承天的招牌武器，所以他的嫌疑最大，也因此引來連番追捕。自此以後，方消聲匿跡。十五年後，年輕女子楊寒雲突然出現，更拿著與當年一樣的神鞭。究竟這位女子是誰？「影子神鞭」的下落又如何？.

programme.title: 船 / My Dream Boat
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下，組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。.

Sasa bingung karena ia tidak bisa mengumpulkan uang untuk membayar utang-utangnya kepada pemilik kontrakan. Dan sebagai gantinya, ia akan menikah dengan kakeknya pemilik kontrakan. programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul

Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Berakhir Bahagia Adisty
programme.desc: Adisty, tulang punggung keluarganya, hampir terjerumus menjadi pekerja seks komersial demi melunasi utang-utang keluarganya. programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Amira, seorang wanita berhati baik yang hidup bahagia bersama suami dan anaknya, harus menghadapi tragedi setelah Aditya berselingkuh. Suami dan putranya tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan, begitu pula bayinya. Amira pun terpuruk dalam duka yang mendalam.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)
programme.desc: Pihu, arwah seorang anak perempuan berusia tujuh tahun, berusaha melindungi ibunya, Anandita, dari segala bahaya dengan bantuan teman sekaligus anak baptisnya, Krishna.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis

programme.title: Big Fish
programme.desc: A young journalist (Billy Crudup) searches for the truth behind the tall tales told by his ailing father (Albert Finney). Starring Ewan McGregor, Albert Finney, Billy Crudup.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: A boy (Wil Wheaton) and his three buddies set out in the summer of 1959 on a hike to find a dead body. Starring Wil Wheaton, River Phoenix, Corey Feldman.

programme.title: Easy Rider
programme.desc: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America. Starring Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper, Jack Nicholson.

programme.title: American Gangster
programme.desc: Frank Lucas, a chauffeur to a mobster, uses his own ingenuity and strict business code to become one of the inner city's most powerful crime bosses. Starring Denzel Washington, Russell Crowe, Chiwetel Ejiofor.

programme.title: Star Wars Kid: The Rise of the Digital Shadows
programme.desc: Ghyslain Raza recalls how he recorded the clip that would change his life and become the first-ever viral-video meme in the early 2000s.

programme.title: Indian Horse
programme.desc: A Canadian First Nations boy survives in a residential school in the 1970s. Starring Sladen Peltier, Forrest Goodluck, Ajuawak Kapashesit.

programme.title: Manufactured Landscapes
programme.desc: The work of photographer Edward Burtynsky includes China's ongoing Industrial Revolution.

programme.title: Upside Down
programme.desc: Though it is forbidden, a man devises a way to reunite with a long-lost love from the twin world that sits just above his own. Starring Kirsten Dunst, Jim Sturgess, Timothy Spall.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! And the Legend of the Vampire
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo (Frank Welker) and the rest of the gang pose as a rock band after a vampire is seen snatching musicians from a concert in Australia. Starring Casey Kasem, Frank Welker, Nicole Jaffe.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi (Dan Aykroyd), Boo Boo (Justin Timberlake), and Ranger Smith (Tom Cavanagh) team up to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers. Starring Dan Aykroyd, Justin Timberlake, Anna Faris.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: With no sanctuary in sight, Helen and Will find themselves living suburban lives that neither of them recognize.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: The exodus from Hollow Earth begins and time is of the essence as the sanctuary stands between the abnormal refuges and the demanding UN; as they try to maintain peace, Helen receives a surprising warning from an unexpected source.

programme.title: Clara
programme.desc: In a race to find intelligent life in the universe, an astronomer and his freethinking research assistant make an inexplicable discovery that changes how they see the world -- and each other. Starring Patrick J. Adams, Troian Bellisario, Kristen Hager.

programme.title: The Unbreakable Boy
programme.desc: When Scott and Teresa learn their son, Austin, is autistic and has brittle bone disease, they worry about his future. However, with Scott's growing faith and Austin's incredible spirit, they find joy, gratitude and courage in the most trying times. Starring Zachary Levi, Meghann Fahy, Patricia Heaton.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: An English orphan (Kate Maberly) discovers her bitter uncle's garden with her sickly cousin (Heydon Prowse), and it is magical. Starring Kate Maberly, Heydon Prowse, Maggie Smith.

programme.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Twentieth-century teenagers (Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes) fall in love, despite feuding families, in an update of the classic tragedy. Starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes, Brian Dennehy.

programme.title: Nomadland
programme.desc: A woman in her sixties embarks on a journey through the American West, living as a van-dwelling modern-day nomad after losing everything in the Great Recession. Starring Frances McDormand, David Strathairn, Linda May.

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: A pregnant police chief (Frances McDormand) probes the murderous events that evolved from a desperate car salesman's (William H. Macy) kidnapping scheme. Starring Frances McDormand, Steve Buscemi, William H. Macy.

programme.title: The Grand Seduction
programme.desc: Residents of a small fishing community in Newfoundland charm a doctor into becoming the town's full-time physician in order to secure a vital factory contract. Starring Brendan Gleeson, Taylor Kitsch, Liane Balaban.

programme.title: French Exit
programme.desc: A widowed New York socialite and her aimless son move to Paris after she spends the last of her husband's inheritance. Starring Michelle Pfeiffer, Lucas Hedges, Tracy Letts.

programme.title: Maliglutit
programme.desc: In 1913 in the Canadian Arctic, Kuanana returns from hunting to find his wife and daughter kidnapped and sets off to find the men who did it. Starring Benjamin Kunuk, Karen Ivalu, Jonah Qunaq.

programme.title: Step Dogs
programme.desc: Meatball, a wise cracking country dog, and Cassie, Hollywood's most pampered pet, meet when their owners get married. The two fight constantly until burglars break into their house, and they must team up to protect their home. Starring Dylan Schmid, Brittney Wilson, Eliana Jones.

programme.title: To the Arctic
programme.desc: With ice melting in their Arctic environment, a polar bear and her two cubs do what they can to adapt and survive.

programme.title: Casablanca
programme.desc: A cynical nightclub owner in Casablanca protects an old flame and her husband from Nazis, while also trying to navigate his complicated past. Starring Humphrey Bogart, Ingrid Bergman, Paul Henreid.

programme.title: The Imitation Game
programme.desc: Genius British logician and cryptologist Alan Turing (Benedict Cumberbatch) helps crack Germany's Enigma Code during World War II but is later prosecuted by his government for illegal homosexual acts. Starring Benedict Cumberbatch, Keira Knightley, Matthew Goode.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: In order to prevent him from altering or destroying the future, Magnus uses Adam Worth's time portal to pursue him to 1898 London.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: As Hollow Earth Abnormals continue to arrive at the surface in droves, Will, Henry, Kate and Bigfoot scramble to prevent war with the Lotus Security Forces; they worry about the whereabouts and safety of Magnus who was last seen heading to Praxis.

programme.title: Long Life, Happiness and Prosperity
programme.desc: A child (Valerie Tian) unwittingly wreaks havoc around her when she tries magic spells to find a new husband for her divorced, overworked mother (Sandra Oh). Starring Sandra Oh, Valerie Tian, Tsai Chin.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: The almost mythical ability of a middle-aged baseball player rockets a major-league team toward the 1939 pennant. Starring Robert Redford, Robert Duvall, Glenn Close.

programme.title: A Little Princess
programme.desc: A British Army captain's (Liam Cunningham) 10-year-old daughter (Liesel Matthews) irks the headmistress (Eleanor Bron) of her girls school in 1914 New York. Starring Eleanor Bron, Liam Cunningham, Liesel Matthews.

programme.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
programme.desc: After the success of "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard is living the dream with sold-out arenas, a devoted fan base, and a thriving career. However, his past soon threatens the family he's built, especially the fragile bond with his son. Starring J. Michael Finley, Milo Ventimiglia, Dennis Quaid.

programme.title: The White Fortress
programme.desc: When a chance encounter brings together two teens from opposite sides of life in post-war Sarajevo, a blossoming romance conceals their desperate and disturbing motives. Starring Pavle Cemerikic, Sumeja Dardagan, Jasmin Geljo.

programme.title: Eighteen
programme.desc: A young man (Paul Anthony) forges new relationships after listening to the World War II stories of his grandfather. Starring Brendan Fletcher, Carly Pope, Mark Hildreth.

programme.title: Crisis
programme.desc: A drug trafficker organizes a smuggling operation while a recovering addict seeks the truth behind her son's disappearance. Starring Gary Oldman, Armie Hammer, Evangeline Lilly.

programme.title: Bride by Mistake
programme.desc: A pilot (Alan Marshal) woos a woman (Marsha Hunt) doubling for an heiress (Laraine Day), then elopes with the heiress. Starring Alan Marshal, Laraine Day, Marsha Hunt.

programme.title: Sun Valley Serenade
programme.desc: A band member sponsors a European war refugee who turns out to be a Nordic skater with eyes for her new guardian. Starring Sonja Henie, John Payne, Glenn Miller.

programme.title: Orchestra Wives
programme.desc: A newlywed (Ann Rutherford) joins her husband (George Montgomery) on the road along with other wives of members of the band. Starring George Montgomery, Ann Rutherford, Glenn Miller.

programme.title: Birth of the Blues
programme.desc: A New Orleans clarinetist (Bing Crosby) forms a Dixieland jazz band with a trumpet player (Brian Donlevy) from Memphis. Starring Bing Crosby, Mary Martin, Brian Donlevy.

programme.title: Girl Crazy
programme.desc: A publisher's playboy son (Mickey Rooney) falls for the dean's granddaughter (Judy Garland) at an all-male mining school. Starring Mickey Rooney, Judy Garland, Gil Stratton.

programme.title: Strike Up the Band
programme.desc: A drummer (Mickey Rooney) and his singer girlfriend (Judy Garland) form a high-school swing band for a radio contest. Starring Mickey Rooney, Judy Garland, June Preisser.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: A harmonica player (James Stewart) woos a landlady's daughter (Paulette Goddard) and joins a conductor's (Horace Heidt) orchestra. Starring James Stewart, Paulette Goddard, Charles Winninger.

programme.title: God Is My Co-Pilot
programme.desc: Col. Robert L. Scott Jr. (Dennis Morgan) becomes a member of Gen. Chennault's (Raymond Massey) Flying Tigers in World War II. Starring Dennis Morgan, Dane Clark, Raymond Massey.

programme.title: My Wild Irish Rose
programme.desc: Irish balladeer Chauncey Olcott charms Lillian Russell and an alderman's daughter in the 1890s New York. Starring Dennis Morgan, Arlene Dahl, Andrea King.

programme.title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
programme.desc: A Brooklyn cabby (Jack Carson) and his manicurist girlfriend (Joan Leslie) meet a prince (Dennis Morgan) posing as a guy from Milwaukee. Starring Dennis Morgan, Jack Carson, Joan Leslie.

programme.title: The Desert Song
programme.desc: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad. Starring Dennis Morgan, Irene Manning, Bruce Cabot.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers. Starring Burt Lancaster, Robert Walker, Joanne Dru.

programme.title: Ten Tall Men
programme.desc: A Foreign Legion sergeant (Burt Lancaster) and his rowdy men settle tribal trouble by seizing a princess (Jody Lawrance). Starring Burt Lancaster, Jody Lawrance, Gilbert Roland.

programme.title: Sweet Smell of Success
programme.desc: An all-powerful New York gossip columnist (Burt Lancaster) gives a press agent (Tony Curtis) some dirty work. Starring Burt Lancaster, Tony Curtis, Martin Milner.

programme.title: From Here to Eternity
programme.desc: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu. Starring Burt Lancaster, Montgomery Clift, Deborah Kerr.

programme.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
programme.desc: Doc Holliday (Kirk Douglas) joins Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and his brothers for a Tombstone showdown with the Clanton gang. Starring Burt Lancaster, Kirk Douglas, Rhonda Fleming.

programme.title: Come Back, Little Sheba
